articleTitle: A Financial data security sharing solution based on blockchain technology and proxy re-encryption technology
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: For the difficulties in sharing sensitive data among financial institutions, hidden dangers in data security, and high financial risk control costs, the paper proposed a secure data sharing solution based on blockchain technology with proxy re-encryption technology. The solution consists of data sharing model and data sharing protocol. Firstly, using the distributed storage, decentralized management and non-tampering characteristics of the blockchain, we designed a data security sharing model. The model sets access control strategies on the blockchain platform, and uses the blockchain platform and distributed databases to store encrypted data together to prevent sensitive data from being tampered with and leaked. The data sharing protocol uses identity-based proxy re-encryption technology and distributed key generation technology. The protocol selects proxy nodes by the proof-of-stake algorithm, and realizes data sharing among users by re-encrypting sensitive data. The analysis of the solution discusses the correctness and security of the proposed scheme in terms of key generation.

articleTitle: Natural Language Processing and Its Applications in Machine Translation: A Diachronic Review
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: As an essential part of artificial intelligence technology, natural language processing is rooted in multiple disciplines such as linguistics, computer science, and mathematics. The rapid advancements in natural language processing provides strong support for machine translation research. This paper first introduces the key concepts and main content of natural language processing, and briefly reviews the history and progress of NLP research at home and abroad. Then, the paper summarizes the three stages of machine translation and its research status. In history, the progress curve of natural language processing almost accords with that of machine translation, and the two complement each other. Based on this, the paper analyzes the applications of natural language processing in machine translation, and points out the challenges and trends in the field of natural language processing. Finally, the author discusses the relationship between machine translation and human translation in the age of artificial intelligence, and visualizes the future prospect of machine translation.

articleTitle: Collision Avoidance Models and Algorithms in the Era of Internet of Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Rear-end crashes and intersection collisions are two common types of accidents in roadways, and a lot of technology and approaches have been used to analyze the vehicle distance and provide effective precautions for drivers. Vehicular Ad-Hoc Network (VANET) can be adopted to share traffic information, select optimal driving route and realize safe driving without any collisions. In this paper, we reviewed a series of models and algorithms in establishing avoidance system for rear-end and intersection collisions. As for rear-end crashes, VK model and neural network had been exploited to release warning messages and realize emergency braking to avoid collisions. Concerning intersection collisions, a spectrum of effective algorithms were put forward to realize collision avoidance in intersection such as Markvo chain. Yet, a handful of challenges should not be neglected in building up efficient collision avoidance system in VANET such as MAC design, information security and effective communications among vehicles. To establish more efficient and accurate collision avoidance system in the environment of VANET, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, 5G technology and automatic technology can be developed and applied in this field in the future.

articleTitle: Space debris detection with fast grid-based learning
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Fast space debris detection is valuable to space safety and space vehicle operation. In this paper, we proposed a fast space debris detection method with grid-based learning. The image divided into 14×14 grids, and then the fast grid-based neural network (FGBNN) is used to locate the position of the space debris in the grids. The experiments show that, In the test set, the model can reach the accuracy of 98.83% and recall of 95.99% with SNR 2 of space debris, it can process 430 images per second with the given experiment settings in the prediction process. It is proved that the proposed method has excellent performance and fast detection speed.

articleTitle: Office Building Energy Consumption Prediction Based on LSTM and SVR
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: According to the actual operating energy consumption of office buildings, this paper proposes an energy consumption prediction method suitable for office building operations in order to efficiently save energy. To achieve more reasonable and accurate predicting results, this method separates prediction into short-term forecast and long-term prediction. Through analysis and selection of energy consumption predictors, we establish an LSTM neural network model for short-term energy consumption prediction and a SVR algorithm based on support vector machines for longterm energy consumption predictions. The prediction results support decision making in building energy-saving operation.

articleTitle: A Survey of Transfer Learning in Breast Cancer Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Worldwide, breast cancer is one of the leading cancer for female, especially in low and middle income countries. Breast cancer's classification in the early stages plays a pivotal role to improve survival rate. But the training dataset which should be large-scaled and well-annotated is hard to collect because of the limitation of data acquisition and annotation. Transfer learning can transfer the knowledge from target domain to source domain to improve model performance. Thus, the dataset needed for training in target domain can be degraded. For the feature mentioned above, it has become the hot topic for research in machine learning. This survey tries to systematize the current research of transfer learning techniques in the area of breast cancer image classification. And also, highlight several findings for the researchers in future.

articleTitle: Design of Electronic Contract Architecture Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: In view of the cumbersome, time-consuming., inefficient, resource-consuming and costly signing process of traditional paper contracts, the paper analyzes the design principles and designs relevant architectures for electronic contracts, which can help enterprises save a lot of resources and improve efficiency. The design covers presentation layer, interface layer, cache management, system management, storage service, multi-chain monitoring and management, secure storage and security management, etc., which can help the electronic contract make full use of its advantages.

articleTitle: Leader-following consensus of multi-agent system with multiple leaders under formation control
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: In this article, the consensus problem of a multiagent system with multiple leaders under formation control is studied. Compared with the previous multi-agent research, this paper solves the formation control problem of multi-agent systems with the consideration of the connection relationship between followers and leaders. The Prim algorithm is used to cut the OFTML (One follower connects to multiple leaders) and redundant connections in the system, which not only reduces the communication traffic in the system, but also makes the leader maintain the connection of 1:n with followers. Convert the original communication topology graph with N leaders into a topology graph with N spanning trees. Then, an effective formation control protocol is proposed to ensure that the multiagent system reaches the desired position, and based on the Lyapunov stability theory, sufficient conditions to ensure the stability of the multi-agent system are obtained. Finally, numerical simulation is used to prove the correctness and validity of the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Discover the Tail Strike Risk during Take-off of an Airline Based on QAR Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: In order to help airlines discover the hidden risks of tail strike during the take-off phase, this article uses the quick access record (QAR) big data of the flight operational quality assurance (FOQA) Station of CAAC, and uses the industry-wide QAR data to compare with the QAR data of individual airline to find out whether an airline has outstanding problems, and uses mathematics Statistical t test to verify whether there is a significant difference. This article analyzes the data from July to December 2019 as an example, and finds that the A321 model of a certain airline has the risk of tail strike, that is, the take-off pitch angle is too big. The t-test of mathematical statistics is used to verify that there is a significant difference between the airline's take-off pitch angle and the industry's take-off pitch angle. In addition, the related speed at rotation, the speed at liftoff, and the average pitch rate are also analyzed, and it is found that they also have significant differences. This method can be further extended to other flight quality analysis to find potential safety hazards.

articleTitle: Improved Particle Swarm Optimization-based Thermal Power-energy Storage Combined AGC Frequency Regulation Control
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Maintaining frequency stability is a prerequisite to ensure safe and reliable operation of the power grid. Based on the purpose of improving the frequency regulation performance of the power grid and efficiently utilizing the frequency regulation resources, a improved particle swarm optimization-based thermal power-energy storage combined automatic power generation control (AGC) frequency regulation control method is proposed. In this method, the AGC frequency regulation control optimization model is established, the dynamic weight coefficient based on the power change rate and acceleration is adopted, the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to optimize the frequency modulation responsibility allocation in real time, and the energy storage SOC real-time management scheme is formulated. By building a regional power grid frequency regulation dynamic model, the simulation and comparison experiments are carried out to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method. This method comprehensively considers the frequency regulation output characteristics of thermal power units and energy storage systems, the operating characteristics and sustainability of energy storage systems and the impact of different types of load disturbances on the AGC frequency regulation responsibility allocation method, which effectively reduces unit loss, increases frequency regulation compensation income and can improve the frequency regulation performance of the power grid while ensuring continuous and efficient operation of the energy storage battery.

articleTitle: Detecting Deepfake Videos via Frame Serialization Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Deepfake, a video forgery technique based on Generative Adversarial Network (GAN), has been proved to be a serious threat to the public security. The images and videos generated with it can even fool human eyes. In this paper, we propose a deep learning-based method to hunt Deepfake videos. A 3D-ResNext based model is developed to effectively learn the leverageable difference between fake videos and benign ones from multiple serialized frames. Furthermore, to address the information loss in compressed videos, the data enhancement technique is introduced in data preprocessing to collect sufficient training samples from public datasets, e.g., FaceForensics++, DeepFakeDetection and DFDC. The experiments demonstrated that our method has good performance and generalization ability in the task of Deepfake videos detection.

articleTitle: Safety Risk Analysis of Railway Accident with Text-based Bow-tie model
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: In order to analyze the safety risk in railway traffic, in this paper, we propose a model applying with Beijing metro accident report. Firstly, we identify the accident causation text from the accident report. Accident causation and its consequences obtained from the accident cause text are summarized. Secondly, establish an accident fault tree based on the text causation and conduct a qualitative analysis on it. To visualize these accident causation, the bow-tie model is introduced. to study the unsafe factors of the accident, and related preventive measures are listed. Thus, proposed model could provide a scientific risk analysis from text accident report.

articleTitle: Research on Artificial Intelligence Machine Learning Character Recognition Based on Online Machine Learning Method
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: The development of artificial intelligence technology has completely transformed human daily life and industrial production mode. Due to the improvement of scientific level and the progress of Internet technology, people have gradually entered the information society, and information technology plays an indispensable role in many application scenarios of daily life and production. With the progress of social science, artificial intelligence technology has also developed rapidly, and people have made breakthrough progress in the research of machine learning. In the past, character recognition methods were based on the image representation of characters, and then the differences between characters were analyzed and processed. With the development of artificial intelligence technology, researchers have studied it more widely and deeply. As a new technical field in artificial intelligence technology, machine learning generally plays an important role in network search, language recognition and other scenarios. This paper will discuss and study the research of character recognition method based on machine learning, and make corresponding arrangement and summary.

articleTitle: Research and application of digital watermark tracing technology in data security protection of power grid
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to study the security control measures when data is distributed and shared, and necessary privacy data protection measures should be taken. On the one hand, when data leakage occurs after data is distributed, it can accurately locate which responsibility link occurs according to the added data watermark information, and then trace the responsibility and strengthen the weak link control. On the other hand, through the joint query technology in the data encryption sharing scenario, this paper studies how to build a trusted security system to ensure the complete trust between the data participants and provide effective support for big data analysis.

articleTitle: The Impact Analysis of COVID-19 on China Various Industries Using Crawler Technology and Data Visualization Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: In order to stop the spread of COVID-19, government has to lockdown of the city from all outside contact. Most of business activities force to stop. This will have an impact on the economic activities. In this paper, first we will use the crawler technology to fetch company's data from Cninfo website. Second, we will use the big data analysis and data visualization technology to analyze the impact of Covid-19 on China various industries. In comparing various industries' profit in the first quarter of 2019 and 2020, we find that except for agriculture, forestry, animal husbandry and fishery, national defense and military, banking, food and beverage industries, the profit value of other industries has declined, with transportation, chemical industry, mining and non-banking financial sector falling the most. On the whole, various industries have been hit by the epidemic.

articleTitle: MobileNet-SSD with adaptive expansion of receptive field
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: With its lightweight structure and acceptable accuracy loss, MobileNet-SSD has been widely used in embedded system. The defect of multi-scale detection structure in the original SSD algorithm makes it insufficient in detecting small targets. In this paper, SKBlock structure is used to adaptively expand the receptive field of SSD shallow feature map to improve its detection ability for small targets. Experiments show that it can effectively improve the target detection ability, and does not increase the computational burden.

articleTitle: An Improved YOLOv3 Model Based on ResNet50
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: In computer vision, object detection is one of the most challenging problems. In the one-stage object detection, YOLOv3 is one of the most popular object detection models. Because of its excellent detection speed and the same accuracy, it has a wide range of practical applications, and many kinds of derivative versions have been derived. In this paper, we used four tricks to upgrade the original yolov3 network which are resnest50, image mixup, label smoothing and CIoU loss. By adding these tricks, the average accuracy and speed of the improved model on coco2017 datasets are better than those of traditional YOLOv3.

articleTitle: Central Real-time Monitoring System for Premature Baby Incubator
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: It is of great importance to provide a neutral temperature environment that is conducive to the growth and development of the premature babies, who have a small gestational age and low weight and therefore are prone to have various growth and development problems. This paper designs a central real-time monitoring system for premature baby incubator by taking environmental temperature control as the main entry point. The incubator collects environment data by using temperature and humidity sensors and web cameras and displays the data of multiple incubators centrally in the central monitoring interface through networking technology so as to realize real-time and centralized monitoring of the living environment and physical state of multiple premature babies. Therefore, the incubator can effectively reduce the probability of medical accidents and safeguard the healthy growth of premature babies. In consideration of the significant influence of environmental noise on the sleep of premature babies, the monitoring and suppression of noise from incubator will be carried out in further studies.

articleTitle: Research on Comparison and Fusion of Traditional Chinese Calligraphy Art and Modern Graphic Design Based on Computer Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: The relationship between graphic design and Chinese calligraphy art is mainly reflected in the modernity, competitiveness and national connotation of graphic design. Calligraphy elements have a special position and value in the inheritance of traditional art. Traditional calligraphy elements have a long history of thousands of years in China, while modern graphic design has only a few decades in China. Chinese characters are created for the needs of life, and they gradually form rich structural forms and have certain artistic features in the process of their emergence and development. With the rise of the Chinese nation and the development of Chinese calligraphy art, modern graphic design is strongly required to reflect the strong traditional characteristics and cultural flavor. From the aesthetic point of view of Chinese calligraphy art, this paper analyzes the relationship between modern graphic design and Chinese calligraphy art based on computer image processing method, and points out the integration path of modern graphic design and Chinese calligraphy art.

articleTitle: SUAV Image Mosaic Based on Rectification for Use in Traffic Accident Scene Diagramming
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: After the traffic accident, it is a very important work on how to collect evidence from the scene, draw accident scene map, and clean up the area as soon as possible, without causing further casualties. In this paper, a method of drawing traffic accident scene map using small Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (SUAV) image mosaic based on rectification is proposed. Firstly, the accident scene images collected by SUAV are preprocessed and rectified through plane homograph. Then, two images are stitched into a large view image through feature point matching and image fusion which contains Harris corner detection and SIFT feature matching algorithm. Finally, taken the accident mosaic image as background, the accident scene map is drawn. Using this method, the scene information can be displayed correctly, which is convenient for the traffic accident scene investigators to draw the accident scene map, and ensure the complete panoramic information collection of the whole scene.

articleTitle: Anonymous Authentication Scheme Based on One-off Public Key in VANET
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: The available anonymous authentication schemes in VANET have some drawbacks in security and efficiency. Then, a new anonymous authentication scheme based on one-off public key is proposed. It constructs the signature of timestamp using the one-off public key as authentication proof to realize anonymous authentication, establishes secure session key and provides the method of revealing malice nodes. It is shown that the proposed scheme has superiority in both security and efficiency, and is more suitable for wireless networks.

articleTitle: Study of mechanical stress distribution in high-voltage cable laying on high-difference terrain
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: The uneven mechanical stress distribution in high-voltage cables is an important cause of frequent cable faults. In order to study the mechanical stress distribution of high-voltage cable laying under high drop terrain conditions, the ANSYS three-dimensional simulation model of high-voltage cable laying was established, and the local damage, side pressure and axial direction of mechanized construction and traditional laying methods were compared and analyzed.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Data Middle Platform Technology in Integrated Energy Business System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: At present, the information of digital and Internet is pushing the social form and infrastructure changes unceasingly, in this highly digital information age, the original data from every industry and in the field of business functions constantly emerge, however the primitive data does not bring value to the enterprise, must be efficiently planning from the Angle of business data to the original data into valuable data assets, thus brings to the enterprise productivity. By comparing the characteristics of data middle platform, data warehouse and data platform, the capability and function of data middle platform are expounded. Combined with the construction of ubiquitous electric power internet of things, it points out the key indicators to be concerned about in the construction of data middle platform, and provides a reference for the construction of enterprise data middle platform.

Author Keywords: ubiquitous electric power internet of things

articleTitle: Research on Computer Software Engineering Database Programming Technology Based on Virtualization Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: The most important advantage of database is that it can form an intensive management system and serve a large number of information users, which shows the importance of information security in network development. However, there are many problems in the current computer software engineering industry, which seriously hinder the development of computer software engineering, among which the most remarkable and prominent one is that the database programming technology is difficult to be effectively utilized. In this paper, virtualization technology is used to manage the underlying resources of data center with the application background of big data technology, and realize the virtualization of network resources, storage resources and computing resources. It can play a constructive role in the construction of data center, integrate traditional and old resources, realize the computing data center system through virtualization, distributed storage and resource scheduling, and realize the clustering and load balancing of non-relational databases.

articleTitle: A novel sensitive chaotic image encryption algorithm based on SHA-3 and steganography
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Chaotic systems are used in many image encryptions. This paper based on SHA-3 and steganography proposes a chaotic image encryption algorithm, which is extremely sensitive to plaintext content. The process of the algorithm is related to the hash value of plain image, makes the process extremely sensitive to the pixels of plain image. Different from other algorithms, this algorithm uses steganography to embed the hash value into the ciphertext image. The scheme does not require an extra channel to transmit the hash value, it has no hash transmission cost and transmission leakage risk. Our Experimental and security analysis show that the proposed algorithm has good security performance and can resist various attacks.

articleTitle: Semi-markov CRF Model Based on Stacked Neural Bi-LSTM for Sequence Labeling
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: In this paper, we present a model for sequence labeling. Based on word vector representations of neural network model algorithms and artificial features of statistical machine learning, a stack Bi-LSTM and new semi-Markov conditional random field frameworks are proposed. On the one hand, we present stack Bi-LSTM to achieve segmentation and chunking task on both word-level and character-level. On the other hand, we use traditional CRF and NSCRF to make some restrictions on the labeling entities to improve the accuracy of labels and then use them to decode the unknown sequence. We test the trained model in the CoNLL2000 and CoNLL2003 datasets.

articleTitle: Research on electromagnetic force wave analysis and vibration characteristics of permanent magnet synchronous motor based on finite element simulation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: The interaction between the fundamental and harmonic magnetic fields in the air gap of motors generates electromagnetic force waves, resulting the vibration of the motor if the motor structure is designed unreasonably. Based on the motion characteristics of permanent magnet synchronous motor and the electromagnetic force wave mechanism, the vibration caused by electromagnetic force of 8-pole 24-slot permanent magnet synchronous motor is studied. Firstly, an ANSYS simulation software is used to establish the finite element model and the magnetic density and magnetic force line distribution of the motor are analyzed. Then, the stator mode and the vibration characteristics of the motor are simulated to study the effect of its natural frequency and its vibration pattern on the motor vibration. The results verify the accuracy and reliability of the model and provide a basis for analyzing and dealing with the motor vibration.

articleTitle: Healthcare on Consumer-grade Wearable Devices
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: The consumer-grade wearable devices contain healthcare functions like fall detection., sleeping monitoring., and ECG. To achieve these functions, companies have to put efforts in considering the material to be suitable for the wearable device, and the sensors equipped in the devices for the healthcare. With the release of some consumer-grade wearable devices for healthcare, people's attitudes towards them are changing, of which the speed is determined by the age.

articleTitle: A Combination of Linear Power Flow Models to Reduce Linearization Error
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: The solution accuracy and efficiency of optimal power flow (OPF) calculation directly determine the economy and safety of power grid operation. The nonlinearity of power flow model leads the non-convex of the economic dispatch model. Linear power flow models are widely used in power systems. Based on general linear power flow model, we combine multiple linear power flow equations with different independent variable functions to obtain a new linear power flow model. A strategy is proposed to build a power flow model library offline. The library could achieve rapid response to different operating condition and further reduce the error of the OPF. The effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed method are verified by OPF calculation in IEEE 30-bus system.

articleTitle: Detection of Jamming in DSSS Systems Using FRESH Filters
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: This paper addresses the problem of blind jamming detection in direct-sequence spread-spectrum (DSSS) systems. The theory of cyclic wiener filter is used as the theoretical basis of the proposed jamming detection technique, named the time varying whitener (TVW)-based detector. The TVW, which is based on the different cyclostationarity properties of the desired signal and the jamming signal respectively, is realized by the frequency-domain adaptive FRESH filter. The FRESH filter, which uses white noise as desired signal, applies the subset of cycle frequencies of the DSSS signal to be the frequency shifts, and is able to whiten the DSSS signal and fix the tap weights of the TVW. Thus, the TVW with fixed tap weights can only whiten the DSSS signal, while pass through the unknown jamming signal. And then we analyze the statistic distribution of the TVW output in order to obtain the detection threshold adaptively. Finally, a jamming decision is made by operating the energy detection for a given false alarm rate and threshold. The numerical results show that receiving structures based on the proposed cyclostationarity-based jamming detection shows robustness to background noise, and outperforms the time invariant whitener, which fails when trying to detect jamming signal.

articleTitle: Design of Lane Keeping Assisted System Based on Improved-Predictive Control Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: In recent years, the active safety of automobiles has become a hot spot for experts and consumers. The Lane Keep Assist System(LKAS) is an auxiliary driving system designed for vehicles to deviate from the lane. The system detects the trajectory of the vehicle when the vehicle deviates from the correct road. It reminds the driver to correct the route or automatically adjusts the driving route to avoid the accident. In this paper, the dynamic matrix simplification factor is designed to improve the predictive control algorithm, and the improved predictive controller is used as the adjustment unit. So that the vehicle can return to a safe driving route smoothly. It has a high research value and practical value.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Emergency Management System for Major Disasters
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: The outbreak of the new type of coronavirus pneumonia has fully exposed some of the problems in the organization and command, capacity building and condition guarantees in the construction of emergency management systems for major emergencies in some provinces and cities in my country. The subject proposes to take the control of major accidents and prevent major disasters as the core objectives, carry out research on the emergency management system and command system at the provincial and municipal level, and build an organization and command structure that is vertical to the bottom and horizontal to the side; To study the capacity building of Chongqing's emergency response system for major emergency disasters, build and improve the emergency response system, including five teams including the “rescue command center, emergency rescue team, emergency support team, after-care team and emergency expert team”, and improve the material and equipment support, Infrastructure guarantee, and emergency management information system capability guarantee, study the legal system, funding policy and other rescue guarantee systems, clarify responsibilities, implement responsibilities, and mobilize the enthusiasm of officers. The research results of the subject will help to form a new pattern of provincial and municipal emergency response systems with agency officers, personnel officers, qualified officers, competent officers, and rules-based officers for major emergencies.

articleTitle: Case-based Reasoning for Resolving the Diversity-accuracy Dilemma of Recommendation System through Subdivision
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Recommendation systems are widely used to help their netizens find what they want from cyber space and many various applications have been developed in different areas like news feeding, entree recommending and online shopping, etc. Many researches have found that their system performance is obsession with diversity-accuracy dilemma, and recommender has to balance recommendation sequence results. CBR-recommender is suggested for it has a comprehensive expression of human sense, logics and result explanation, and has more system flexibility to integrate many AI tools in dealing with such diversity-accuracy dilemma. Covering algorithm is also proposed to dynamically cluster similar users or items as subdomain for which all users are dynamitic divided into multiple clusters according to a certain criterion. Our experiments results indicate that users with similar hobbies are assigned to the same sub-domain as many specific sub-classes, and the refined classification results are more conducive for the problem-solving.

articleTitle: Establish of fuzzy synthetic evaluation model and China coal mine safety risk analysis system
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: In order to scientific manage the mine risk and safety events which under the supervision of the government regulatory departments and coal mining enterprises. The factors affecting coal mine safety risk are identified synthetically by AHP analysis method, and the index system of coal mine safety risk assessment is constructed from the aspects of personnel, equipment, environment, management, etc. It uses cloud computing, GIS, big data analysis and visual technology, which takes a basis of SOA technology architecture and data warehouse, that help realizes the analysis of the coal mine safety risk system, the analysis of the coal mine safety status, prevention of the coal mine safety accident and provides the reliable judgment basis for the auxiliary decision of the coal mine safety production. The system has been applied in many projects such as the National Mine Safety Production Supervision IoT application demonstration project and the coal mine accident risk analysis platform of Chongqing Coal Mine Safety Supervision Bureau, which improves the information regulate standard of coal mine using by national and regional authorities.

articleTitle: Simulate the number of confirmed COVID-19 Cases in 9 Countries from January to June 2020 based on 3 Models
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Currently, the COVID-19 pandemic has been effectively controlled in China. However, the situation remains grim in several other countries around the world - with continued risk and adverse impact on the safety and lives of people, industrial production, and societal activities. In this context, this study aims to analyze and simulate the number of confirmed cases in 9 countries (US, Brazil, Chile, India, Russia, Peru, Pakistan, Mexico and Saudi Arabia) affected by severe COVID-19 outbreaks from January to June 2020, in order to provide potential guidance for the prevention and control of COVID-19. More specifically, one infectious disease model (SEIR, Susceptible Exposed Infectious Removed) and two time-series models (ARIMA, Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average and LSTM, Long Short-Term Memory) were adopted to simulate the number of confirmed COVID-19 cases in these countries. A comparison between the simulated results obtained via these 3 models demonstrates that the time-series models (ARIMA and LSTM) yield good results only on a short-term scale. The average Mean Squared Logarithmic Error (MSLE) of ARIMA on the test set was observed to be 0.11, while that of LSTM was 0.12. However, on a long-term scale, these two models were unable to forecast the inflection point of the pandemic, with error exhibiting a gradual increase with time. In comparison, the improved SEIR model exhibited an average MSLE of 2.25 on the test set, but yielded more accurate longterm forecasts.

articleTitle: Application of Face Data Augmentation Based on Rotate-and-Render-DCGAN in Campus Security
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Targeting at solving the problem of low accuracy of existing recognition methods caused by the imbalance of face data sets in the university security system, an unbalanced Data Augmentation method based on Rotate-and-Render-DCGAN is proposed to improve face recognition accuracy campus. Our goal is to correct the angled faces in the data set through Rotate-and-Render and generate artificial images to enrich the image database combined with DCGAN to improve the classifier's performance and the accuracy of face recognition. We evaluate and compare the impact of traditional Data Augmentation and Rotate-and-Render- DCGAN Data Augmentation on face recognition accuracy. The results show that the improvement effect of this method is more significant.

articleTitle: Research on Design of Folding Multifunctional Furniture Based on Computer Image Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: In today's high-tech development society, design is a kind of life, which changes life and is also changed by life. The unique perspective of Chinese furniture images shows the cultural precipitation of Chinese people in its own way. This paper divides multifunctional furniture into cell combination type and folding structure type. Based on the theory of folding structure, the multifunctional furniture with folding structure is deeply studied. This paper expounds the physical and emotional characteristics of materials in furniture design from the perspective of perception, expounds the graphic design method of folding multifunctional furniture, and at the same time makes an experimental study on the process of transforming intention cognition into practical application, and obtains the image average value and key parameters of material emotion contrast, so as to promote the application of material emotion in furniture design.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Chat Robot Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet technologies such as big data and artificial intelligence, chat robots have begun to enter people's daily life, providing a lot of convenience for people's life and work. At present, many research institutions focus on the research and development of chat robots, but this field is still in its infancy, and chat robots in the market are more or less deficient. Based on the deep learning technology in big data, this paper constructs and trains the model of attention mechanism, and realizes the generative dialogue chat robot in the open field, which can intelligently generate smooth responses according to the wide input of users; The model is implemented by deep learning TensorFlow coding library, and the results show that the model proposed in this paper is better than the traditional language model in continuous and meaningful dialogue.

articleTitle: Iterative Algorithm for the Reflexive Solution of a Sylvester Quaternion K-conjugate Matrix Equation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: We in this paper study the reflexive solution of a Sylvester quaternion k-conjugate matrix equation. We first give an iterative algorithm for the solution of the problem. Then we prove that the algorithm will generate a solution with high efficiency, when the problem is solvable. Finally, we present an example to show the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Interface Design of Meteorological Cloud Radars Based on Cognitive Load Theory
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: The digital interface is the medium for human-computer interaction. Since the digital interface of meteorological cloud radar is of numerous terms and strong professionalism., the rationality of digital interface design is becoming one of the significant factors reducing the cognitive load of users in human-computer interaction and affecting the performance of the product. Based on the design practice., this paper analyzes the existing defects of the cloud radar interface through process analysis and user feedback., and optimizes the interface design based on cognitive load theory. It was verified that the new design effectively reduced the users” cognitive load through the eye movement experiment from aspects of fixation time., completion time., pupil diameter and NASA-TLX cognitive load 6-dimensional scale. On this basis., the design method for the human-computer interaction of the meteorological weather radar is further refined and summarized, which contributes a reference for interface design in this field.

articleTitle: A scalable file management protocol for high speed storage system
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: T In the implementation of the whole high-speed storage system, file management technology plays an important role in the speed of data recording, data indexing and extraction. At present, file management system is divided into custom file system and general standard file system. The file management protocol combines the high bandwidth performance of custom file system and the flexible expansion of storage capacity and speed of standard file system, and has good user experience. After testing, when the storage capacity of the high-speed storage system is 12t, the data acquisition and transmission speed can reach 6.4GBPS, and the data playback speed can reach 7 GBPS; under the same other conditions, the file management system can flexibly expand the storage capacity and storage speed, and the estimated data playback speed can reach 8GBPS.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Image Recognition Scheme Based on 3D Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Image is a reflection of objective reality in a certain sense, which conveys information to human beings in different modes. As an important information carrier, image is intuitive, rich in content and easy to communicate, which is an important content of multimedia. With the wide application of 3D images, image recognition based on 3D technology has attracted more researchers' attention, and there are more and more recognition methods. Human beings rely on two-dimensional images to perceive the three-dimensional world, and using computers to accomplish the same thing is the main research content in the field of computer vision. At any particular moment, the points on the target in the image correspond one-to-one with the points on the real three-dimensional target object. The images acquired by the imaging system are often not directly applicable due to various conditions and random interference. Based on the three-dimensional technology, this paper studies the digital image recognition scheme, and analyzes the image processing such as grayscale correction and noise filtering.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Computer Network Information Security Protection Based on Secure Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: In the current development of information technology, big data has become one of its important features. Moreover, with the rapid development of big data related technologies, the threat degree of computer information in China is increasing. Under the background of big data, information data grows rapidly, which makes it easier for people to obtain valuable information. However, people are faced with more and more information security problems, and it is increasingly difficult to maintain information security. In this paper, based on the security big data, the factors affecting the information security of computer network are analyzed, and the specific countermeasures are studied based on the background of big data. The purpose is to provide reference for relevant personnel and improve the stability and security of data information.

articleTitle: A Second Order Cone Relaxation WLS Based NLOS Mitigation Algorithm for WSN Localization
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: NLOS (non Line of Sight) problem has been a main impact on TOF/TDOA based localization algorithm in WSN network. In this paper, a second-order cone relaxation weighted least square (SOCR-WLS) is proposed to mitigate NLOS. The method simplifies the constraint conditions of weighted least square formulation by second-order cone relaxation, and presents a new NLOS weight updating scheme. The proposed method does not need any statistical property or parameters. Simulation results show that the proposed SOCR-WLS based NLOS mitigation algorithm is more robust than the existed methods.

articleTitle: Analysis and Countermeasure on Information Security in Universities
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Universities shoulder the important mission of cultivating and providing talents for the society, carrying out scientific research and experiments and transforming achievements. The security and stability of universities are important factors concerning the stable development of society. Working on the information security in universities is the strategic deployment that implements the overall national security concept persisted by the CPC Central Committee and paves out a path of national security with Chinese characteristics. This paper summarizes the connotation and main work of information security in universities, analyzes the current situation of information security protection in universities from four aspects: resistance capacity of information security, overall environment of security protection system, working mode of information construction and security awareness of all personnel in universities, and concludes the countermeasures of constructing security protection system in universities.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Network Information Security and Protection Strategy Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: With the continuous development of network technology and information technology, network has become an indispensable part of people's daily life and production, and with the increasing demand for network information. The rapid development of computer network brings convenience to people's lives, but it also produces a series of computer network security problems, which infringe on people's privacy and interests. In view of this, based on the Internet of Things, this paper discusses the security of computer network information in detail, mainly analyzes the security problems existing in the current computer network information, and puts forward some targeted protection strategies, in order to ensure the security performance of computer network information and ensure the reliable, continuous and stable operation of computer network system.

articleTitle: Research on Reliability Optimization Model Construction of Embedded Electronic Information System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of inaccurate optimization in traditional reliability optimization methods, this research proposes a new reliability optimization method for embedded electronic information systems. Through analyzing the working principle of embedded electronic information system, the fault density function, failure rate, average life and availability of embedded electronic information system are optimized. This study establishes a model that restricts the reliability of embedded electronic information systems, so that the failure rate of embedded electronic information systems is reduced, the average life span is extended, and the reliability is significantly improved.

articleTitle: Consensus of multi-agent systems with adaptive coupling weight and communication delays
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: The problem of adaptive coupling multi-agent systems with communication delays is considered in this paper. First, the error system is constructed, and leader-following consensus problem is transformed into the stability problem of the local error system. Then, based on Lyapunov theory and techniques in matrix theory and inequalities, the conditions are obtained to ensure the achievement of leader-following consensus of multi-agent systems. Moreover, an adaptive coupling weight updating scheme is proposed to ensure leader-following consensus. Finally, a simulation is verified the correctness and strength of the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Research on High Precision Dynamic Relative Positioning Technology Based on the Third Generation BDS
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, the demand for high precision positioning technology is increasing in human scientific research and life. China's Third-generation BeiDou navigation satellite system has also launched global navigation positioning and timing services. RTK positioning method is used to build a dynamic mobile station relative to the dynamic reference station positioning system. Comparing the advantages and disadvantages of pure inertial navigation and pure GNSS navigation, a combined navigation mode is designed which integrates the advantages of two positioning methods. The software engineering solution is thus designed to observe the solution results in real time by dynamic window, and to test the feasibility and hardware performance of the dynamic positioning system. The hardware design as well as the implementation scheme is developed, together with the navigation data collected and the performance of long time dynamic positioning solution and robust performance of the system tested in open and complex environment and so on. The dynamic positioning system is designed with high positioning accuracy and good robustness, which is suitable for the application of high precision relative alignment of linkage target.

articleTitle: Risk analysis of gaseous SO3 sulfonation reactor system based on HAZOP-LOPA
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Based on the analysis of the deficiencies of HAZOP, it is presented that the integration of HAZOP with LOPA can obtain the HAZOP-LOPA evaluation method, which can further reduce the risk level of the sulfonated reaction system. For the analysis of the sulfonation reactor system in the gaseous SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> sulfonation process, in the analysis process, the HAZOP method is first used to identify and analyze the existing accident risk in the system. The deviation analysis shows that the temperature of the sulfonation reactor system is easy to lose control and the conversion efficiency is too low. Furtherly using the layer of protection analysis, considering the high temperature of the reactor system after the unefficient cooling water as the initial event, analysis the failure consequences and calculate the probability of accident consequences, and assess the risk level of the existing protection value. The inherent risks and residual risks determine the risk controlling measures so that the risks can be taken under control. The results show that the HAZOP-LOPA evaluation method can quantify the risk and improve the effect of safety analysis. It is an effective method to improve the accuracy and scientificity of risk assessment results.

articleTitle: Development of frequency synthesizer for Ku band surface surveillance radar
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: A design method of Ku-band high performance frequency synthesizer is introduced in this paper. Based on the traditional in loop mixing phase locking method, the influence of additional phase noise of digital phase detector, frequency divider and other components on the output phase noise performance is reduced through reasonable frequency planning, optimization of bias frequency and frequency division ratio. The developed frequency synthesizer has low spurious and the phase noise performance similar to that of direct frequency synthesis is obtained, which has good engineering application. At the same time, the volume of frequency synthesizer is greatly reduced by adopting 3D assembly technology of RF heterogeneous integration, which provide one method for the miniaturization of frequency synthesizer.

articleTitle: An Approach of LPI Radar Signal Detection Based on Visibility Graph
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: There is an urgent need to address the crucial problems caused by more and more low energy and complex of radar signals in the radar countermeasure field. In 2009, Luque et al. introduced a visibility algorithm to describe time series. In this paper, the visibility graph is applied to radar signal detection. Adjacency matrix of visibility graph is adapted to complex and various electromagnetic environment. On the other hand, differential power spectral density has advantage on low probability of intercept (LPI) radar signal detection. Except for linear frequency modulation (LFM), the proposed approach is efficient to most of LPI modulation types, such as frequency shift keying (FSK), sinusoidal frequency modulation (SFM), binary phase shift keying (BPSK) and LFM-BPSK combined modulation. 1000 Monte Carlo simulation results shows detection probability can reach 92% under -5 dB signal noise ratio (SNR).

articleTitle: Application of “Game Engine + Visual Programming” Mode in Cluster Animation Creation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Cluster animation is mainly used to simulate the activities of a group of organisms in the same environment. The behavior of this group of organisms is different from that of individuals, that is, the so-called cluster phenomena, such as the migration of birds, the swimming of fish, the movement of enemies in games, and the movement of characters in large-scale scenes in movies. The research contents of group animation include: individual modeling, motion control and group animation drawing. Motion control mainly refers to the planning of group motion, including path planning, intelligent interaction between individuals and so on. This paper mainly uses game engine unity and visual programming to playmaker the application of two development modes in cluster animation.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Programming of Training Airspace Based on Genetic-Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Aiming at the dynamic programming problem of training airspace, on the basis of analyzing the complexity of the problem, the spatial planning model is constructed, and the genetic-discrete particle swarm optimization algorithm is proposed. By integrating the crossover and mutation ideas in the genetic algorithm, the DPSO algorithm's ability to get rid of the local optimal solution is improved, and the convergence speed and accuracy of the algorithm are improved. In order to ensure the diversity of the population, the adaptive crossover operator and mutation operator are designed. Finally, The improved genetic-particle swarm optimization algorithm is used as an example. Compared with the traditional PSO algorithm, the results show that the algorithm has better results and faster convergence speed.

articleTitle: Image-based Discovery of the Coupled Schrodinger Equations
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Recently, deep learning has proven to be a powerful methodology for uncertainty quantification for a vast number of physical systems. Generally, partial differential equations are used to describe these physical phenomena. Since the system of coupled nonlinear Schrodinger equations, which plays an important in physics and modern communication technology. Therefore, in this work, we used a deep learning method to discover the numerical solutions of the systems, to help us better understand the physical world, and to promote the rapid development of current communication technology. Additionally, numerous numerical experiments are conducted to exhibit the numerical performance of the method, and which shows the deep learning method to solve partial differential equations (PDEs) is greatly important for the uncertainty quantification analysis.

articleTitle: A Structural View of Assessment in Conversation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Assessment serves as a key function and provides important resources for introspecting collaborative talk. This paper describes a corpus-based investigation into the dialogue act assessment in daily conversation. In particular, it attempts to answer questions on the distinct linguistic expressions and structures by native speakers. It has been found that adjective phrases tend to dominate assessment utterances, with five structural subcategories, each slot embedded with a set of restricted expressions. In addition, the preceding contexts are taken into account to differentiate assessments from nonassessment functions with statistical evidence. It is arguable that studying the correlation between forms and functions would offer valuable insights to the construction of human-machine dialogue system.

articleTitle: Simulation Technology for the Testability of Inertial Navigation Systems and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Fault diagnosis is becoming increasingly difficult because of the complexity and diversity of electronic products and equipment. Therefore, the testability of products has gradually attracted the attention of manufacturers and users. To evaluate the testability level of products in the development stage, this study performs a failure mode and effect analysis. A testability model is then established for the testability simulation analysis. The feasibility and effectiveness of this method are then verified by taking an inertial navigation system as an example. Results highlight the benefits of the quantitative evaluation of testability in the early stage of product design and the identification of weak links in product testability design so as to provide suggestions for product design improvement.

articleTitle: Snow Environment Measurement System Based on BP Model to Predict Freestyle Skiing Launch Speed of Sportsman
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Freestyle skiing aerials is a sport that attracts people's attention and love. The launch speed is very important for freestyle skiing. In addition to its own movement adjustment, it is also affected by environmental resistance factors such as wind speed, wind direction and snow surface friction resistance. In this paper., a freestyle skier's speed quantitative prediction system composed of snow environment measurement system and BP neural network prediction model is designed. The researchers went to the ski resort to make field measurements and used the real-time data measured by the snow environment measurement system and the athlete's own parameters as inputs to the prediction model. Finally., the predicted value of the launch speed is obtained., which is convenient for the coach to provide an effective scientific reference and improve the athlete's competition performance.

articleTitle: Research on dynamic development of vibrating gyroscope based on coriolis effect
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: The basic principle of Coriolis effect based vibrating gyro is briefly summarized. The structure, technology and performance of typical vibrating gyro based on Coriolis effect are analyzed. The development trend of vibrating gyro is prospected through analyzing the structure, technology and performance of a few typical Coriolis effect based vibrating gyro. A new design scheme of Coriolis effect based vibrating-wire gyro is proposed based on the development of high precision and miniaturization of vibrating gyro. It will provide a new idea for effectively solving the problem of high precision and miniaturization of the gyro, and has important theory value and application significance.

articleTitle: Study on an improved Lie Group machine learning-based classification algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: In order to address the problem that the geodesic distance of Lie Group machine learning method has failed to use the sample class information, this paper proposes an improved Lie Group machine learning algorithm. Firstly, this algorithm maps the vector space consisting of sample dataset into a differential manifold, and each sample corresponds to a point in the manifold structure; then, the differentiation value is used to replace the Euclidean distance for calculation of the geodesic distance between samples, and the class of test sample is determined according to the geodesic distance relation between the test sample and the sample in training dataset. The results of classification experiment prove that compared with the traditional Lie Group machine learning classification (LGC) algorithm, the K-nearest neighbor (KNN) algorithm and support vector machine (SVM) classification\algorithm, the improved classification algorithm has higher classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Lag synchronization of the leader-following neural networks with time delay based on an improved controller
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Considering that time delay, as an essential characteristic of neural network system, can't be completely eliminated in many high-tech fields, which affects the stability and efficiency of the system, and many classical controllers can't meet the practical conditions. For the sake of solve this problem, an improved dynamic distributed state feedback controller based on the leader follower complex dynamic network with time delay was proposed, and a nonlinear term to the network was added. By selecting appropriate Lyapunov function and linear inequality method, ample conditions are acquired to make the intricate dynamic delay network achieve lag synchronization. Ultimate, the validity of the lag synchronization condition is proved by digital simulation.

articleTitle: Study on a New Sparse Rule Algorithm in Liver Disease
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Most of the current diagnostic methods of liver diseases are black box model which can't fully display the information hidden in the data.In this paper, we propose a new spare rule extraction algorithm on the basis of random forest, combined with elastic L1 and L2 norm regularization to select high precision and interpretable diagnostic rules. The method is compared with the state of art techniques in hepatitis dataset and the experimental results show that our method can extract more accurate, concise and strong explanatory rules. We believe that the proposed approach achieve excellent performance in tradeoff curve and more effectively predict the risk of liver disease in the health care environment.

articleTitle: Interference Analysis for Downlink Transmission in Two-tier Heterogeneous Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: In this paper, we analyze the performance of outage probability for downlink transmission in two-tier heterogeneous cellular networks. In order to save spectrum resources, we adopt frequency reuse scheme, which will result in cross-tier interferences. The macro base station (MBS) provides useful signal for macro user equipment (MUE), in contrast, the signals provided by small base stations (SBSs) around MUE becoming the interferences. We use Fenton-Wilkinson method and Farley method to approximate the sum of multiple interferences, these two methods can simplify the calculation of outage probability and then we compare the approximation results. The derived expressions are validated by the Monte Carlo simulations and simulation results are generated to assess the feasibility of two methods' accuracy and the circumstance of applications.

articleTitle: Protection and Development of Traditional Arts and Crafts Based on Computer 3D Animation Modeling Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: As a material carrier of culture, traditional arts and crafts are an important part of Chinese traditional culture. It is both material and immaterial. As a commodity production, it has great economic value. In Chinese cultural tradition, not only arts and crafts merge, but also arts and crafts merge with politics. As an advanced design method, 3D digital technology has the advantages of convenient operation, high efficiency and intuitive expression, which plays a great role in promoting the industrialization of traditional arts and crafts. The 3D data needed in the process of modeling can form arbitrary views, and each view can maintain a reasonable projection relationship. Chinese national folk culture is a kind of culture of sustainable development, which accumulates the ideas, ways and behaviors of sustainable development, which is worth us to excavate, inherit and carry forward. Based on computer 3D animation modeling technology, the advantages of traditional arts and crafts design and its application in traditional arts and crafts are discussed and analyzed in detail.

articleTitle: A Theory on AI Uncertainty Based on Rademacher Complexity and Shannon Entropy
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: In this paper, we present a theoretical discussion on AI deep learning neural network uncertainty investigation based on the classical Rademacher complexity and Shannon entropy. First it is shown that the classical Rademacher complexity and Shannon entropy is closely related by quantity by definitions. Secondly based on the Shannon mathematical theory on communication [3], we derive a criteria to ensure AI correctness and accuracy in classifications problems. Last but not the least based on Peter Barlette's work in [1], we show both a relaxing condition and a stricter condition to guarantee the correctness and accuracy in AI classification. By elucidating in this paper criteria condition in terms of Shannon entropy based on Shannon theory, it becomes easier to explore other criteria in terms of other complexity measurements such as Vapnik-Cheronenkis, Gaussian complexity by taking advantage of the relations studies results in other references such as in [2]. A close to 1/2 criteria on Shannon entropy is derived in this paper for the theoretical investigation of AI accuracy and correctness for classification problems.

articleTitle: Parameters' Optimization for Automobile Steering Mechanism System Based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: The optimal design of the steering mechanism of a pure rolling automobile has always been one of the important goals pursued by automobile designers. If the parameters of the steering mechanism are designed reasonably, it can effectively reduce the wear of the tires during the turning process of the automobile. This paper proposes a method to quickly optimize the design of the steering mechanism of an automobile, which can quickly find the basic parameters under certain conditions, which is the cumulative sum of the absolute difference between the ideal rack length and the actual rack length required for pure rolling. Research has shown that the bottom angle of the steering knuckle arm is the most sensitive to the changing of the rack length. The length of the steering knuckle arm has an exact optimal solution. Through parameter optimization, the traditional design scheme can play its full potential. A MATLAB program on the parameterized optimization of rack and pinion steering mechanism is written to provide a reference for this kind of steering mechanism design.

articleTitle: Vehicle Speech Enhancement Algorithm Based on TanhDBN
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Vehicle speech enhancement has long been a challenging issue owing to the system that exhibits nonlinearity, strong noise and strong interference in the vehicle environment. In this paper, a vehicle speech enhancement algorithm based on the combination of deep belief network and wiener filtering is proposed. First, the quantum particle swarm optimization (QPSO) algorithm is employed to optimize the parameters of the deep belief networks (DBN) model. Then, to learn better features of the input vehicle Speech signal, a hyperbolic tangent (tanh) function is used to replace the traditional sigmoid function of DBN. Finally, the learned high-level speech feature signals are inputted to the wiener filtering algorithm for speech enhancement. Experimental results show that the proposed method can effectively eliminate the noise of the original speech signal and effectively enhance the processed speech signal. Meanwhile, the information of the original speech signal can be retained.

articleTitle: Application Analysis of Reasoning Engine Based on Artificial Intelligence in Medical Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Recently, medical engineering research has developed rapidly. With the improvement of measuring instrument technology, a large amount of medical information can be recorded accurately, which leads to explosive growth of medical data. Under this background, we will face a large amount of data, and it is very important to mine and utilize this huge amount of data reasonably. Applying artificial intelligence reasoning engine to medical data search can collect keywords used by users and recommend interesting information to users immediately. This paper introduces the related knowledge of data mining technology, expounds the key technologies to realize data mining, especially the decision tree algorithm, and discusses the application of data mining technology in clinical medical diagnosis mining and analysis.

articleTitle: Construction and Application of Intelligent Terminal Perception Test Analysis System Based on Mobile Internet
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: With the rapid development of wireless communication industry, mobile phones have become an indispensable part of people's lives, so the requirements for the extended functions of its software are increasing day by day. Context-aware applications have changed the way of human-computer interaction in the past, and can provide appropriate services spontaneously and actively according to the current state of users. The user perception test and analysis system based on mobile phone business hall APP, the business event analysis function of the system is closer to the real user's business perception, and through rich data analysis, it can help the operation and maintenance personnel to accurately locate problems and improve the user perception analysis ability. Through comprehensive analysis of terminal equipment types, service types, service characteristics, user habits, etc., we can make reasonable responses to service calls from different terminals and users, so as to achieve the goal of scientifically allocating bandwidth resources and optimizing the mobile network, and greatly improve the timely rate of complaint handling and the accuracy of fault location.

articleTitle: Research on the Effect of Early Signal Increasing for Rotating Machinery by MED and MCKD
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: The key to early fault feature extraction of rotating machinery is to effectively enhance the weak vibration signal of early faults. This article first analyzes the minimum entropy deconvolution and maximum correlation kurtosis deconvolution methods, and gives the calculation process of the two methods. The effectiveness of the methods of minimum entropy deconvolution and maximum correlation kurtosis deconvolution on weak information enhancement is analyzed through simulation signals, and the enhancement effects are analyzed and compared.

articleTitle: Automatic Error Correction Technology for the Same Field in the Same Kind of Power Equipment Account Data
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Account data of electrical power system is the link of all businesses in the whole life cycle of equipment. It is of great significance to improve the data quality of power equipment account data for improving the information level of power enterprises. In the past, there was only the error correction technology to check whether it was empty and whether it contained garbled code. The error correction technology for same field of the same kind of power equipment account data is proposed in this paper. Combined with the characteristics of production business, the possible similar power equipment can be found through the function location type and other fields of power equipment account data. Based on the principle of search scoring, the horizontal comparison is used to search and score in turn. Finally, the potential spare parts and existing data quality are identified according to the scores. And judge whether it is necessary to carry out inspection maintenance.

articleTitle: Wide Range and Dynamic Video Image Stabilization Applied in UAV Aerial Photographing
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: In the process of aerial photographing, due to the wide range of complex scene conditions such as air flow changes and the influence of light and atmosphere, which lead to the large dynamic instability phenomenon such as mechanical vibration and even violent shaking when the camera carrier moves, this paper proposes a new video stabilization algorithm for the wide range and large dynamic state.
