Firstly, the feature points of reference frame are extracted by GFTT algorithm, and the motion vector between frames is obtained by using sparse optical flow method to find matching feature points in the current frame of continuous video image. Secondly, on the basis of traditional Kalman filter, a hybrid filter composed of Kalman filter and Gauss discrete filter is used to smooth the motion of each frame image. Finally, a stable video sequence is obtained by motion compensation. The experimental results show that the MSE parameters of this algorithm are 21.4% lower than those of the traditional Kalman filter based image stabilization algorithm, which can meet the requirements of wide range and dynamic video image stabilization.

Author Keywords: MSE parameter of mean square error

articleTitle: Object Detection in RGB-D Image Based on Two-stream SSD
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Aiming at an unsatisfactory detection performance due to the limitation of the object detection method using color image or depth image alone, a two-stream SSD detection network combining color image and depth image is proposed, the depth map channel network is added on the basis of the original SSD detection network, the color information and the depth information are merged in different ways on the feature layer of the two-stream network, and the different features of the color map and the depth map are fully utilized, thereby effectively overcame the disadvantages of detection by single image, improved the accuracy of the object detection and the robustness of the environment. The experimental results on the SUN RGB-D dataset show that compared to the SSD detection network using color image alone and the SSD detection network using depth image alone, the accuracy of the proposed network is improved by 3.0 percentage points and 8.2 percentage points, respectively, and the detection rate on the GTX 1080 Ti is about 17FPS.

articleTitle: An on-line monitoring system of mine main ventilator based on PLC technology
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: As the “lung” of coal mine, the main ventilator of coal mine is directly related to the production safety of the whole coal mine. For the purpose of ensuring the safe operation of the main ventilator in coal mine, improving the level of digital construction in coal mine, improving the stability, reliability, automation degree of fan system and reducing the downtime of reverse machine, this paper puts forward the control system of automatic monitoring and monitoring of main ventilator by collecting field digital quantity, analog data, 485 communication data, Ethernet communication data, cooperating with high and low voltage switch, frequency converter, air door control box, monitoring camera and so on. The practical application shows that the system has the characteristics of safety and reliability, simple operation, easy maintenance, convenient expansion and flexible configuration. The system provides functions such as one-click reverse machine, one-click backwind, alarm record, real-time data, historical data, report query and so on. The system greatly improves the automation level, safety and reliability of coal mine ventilator control system.

articleTitle: Calculation and Simulation of Magnetic Dipole Fields in Seawater
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Based on the magnetic dipole which is one of the basic electromagnetic radiation sources, the approximate analytical solution of its electromagnet field is derived from basic Maxwell's equation and Helmholtz equation in this paper. The radiation quasi stable conditions in the near-field region are analyzed in the frequency band of 200 Hz-1000 Hz. Finally, the 3D full wave electromagnetic simulation results in air and seawater are compared and analyzed, and the sea water species related is obtained The characteristics of the magnetic dipole field in the spatial range of the band which we concerned provide theoretical and data support for the analysis of the electromagnetic field of the magnetic dipole in the unstable condition.

articleTitle: Stochastic Recursive Zero-Sum Differential Game and Mixed Zero-Sum Differential Game Problem with Payoff Functional in BDSDES
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: In this paper, we study stochastic recursive (mixed) zero-sum differential game and this game problem' payoff functional is depicted by the forms of a backward doubly stochastic differential equation'solution. The major means are backward doubly stochastic differential equations (BDSDEs) and double-barrier reflected BDSDEs.in such case, we confirmed the truth of that a saddle point of the stochastic recursive differential game problem above-mentioned is existed and obtained the optimal payoff functional.

articleTitle: Research on Furnace Temperature Curve Model Based on Heat Radiation Theory
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: In this paper, the differential equation model and difference equation model of furnace temperature curve based on heat radiation principle are established by using the knowledge of thermodynamics. The least square method is used to process the experimental data of furnace temperature curve, and the unknown parameters in the model is obtained. Then the theoretical value of the furnace temperature curve is calculated by using the determined difference equation model. The results show that the theoretical values are in good agreement with the experimental values, which verifies the rationality of the established model. Finally, the optimal selection method of maximum furnace speed based on dichotomy is proposed in combination with the model.

articleTitle: Trends and Countermeasures of Next Generation Telemetry Technology Innovation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: With an analysis of new test requirements of next-generation aviation weapons and equipment, this article focus on summarising the current development of existing telemetry technology and shortcomings of flight test capability on new aviation weapons and equipment and comes up with a new generation telemetry system framework. In this article telemetry system networking, intelligent monitoring, and data fusion of new generation telemetry system are elaborated and trends of development of telemetry technique in flight tests are prospected.

articleTitle: Insulated short pole operation method of live operation in the electrical system
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: In recent years, with the rising of electricity demand living work becomes more and more important. To ensure the daily use of electricity, in the electric power of high voltage line maintenance is particularly important. The bypass operation method as a continuous electrical operation of the classic methods, has wide application. At the same time, we put forward a bypass operation method combined with insulating rod living work method, make continuous electrical operation more simple operation, and has higher security.

articleTitle: Calculation method of efficiency of reconnaissance image based on pixel method
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of evaluating the efficiency index of the reconnaissance submunition reconnaissance image during the experiment, the pixel method is designed to evaluate the reconnaissance range of the target area.

articleTitle: Prune Strategy to YOLO-Based Model
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: One-stage networks have been widely used in target detection systems that need to learn from the big data. Most of them have good real-time performance and accuracy. However, due to their convolution structure, in actual applications, they still require more memory space and stronger computing power, thereby we choose to apply a pruning strategy on the target detection network to reduce the size of the network model and the number of parameters. In order to prove the practicability of the pruning method, we select the YOLOv3 model for experiments and provide a crop data set collected in the orchard to show the model effect. In this data set, in the best case, the volume of the network model is reduced by 52.7% compared with the original model, and the reasoning time is reduced by 57.5%. At the same time, it also uses data processing methods to compensate for the decrease in accuracy caused by pruning.

articleTitle: A New Trusted Inter-Domain Authentication Scheme for Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Based on identity-based signature scheme and direct anonymous attestation of trusted computing, a new trusted inter-domain authentication scheme for wireless networks was proposed. It realizes identity authentication by using identity-based signature scheme to construct authentication proof, and uses direct anonymous attestation to verify the trustiness of platform. It is showed that the proposed scheme not only could achieve mutual authentication, but also has a secure anonymity, and could realize verifying the trustiness of platform. Compared with available schemes, the proposed scheme has superiority in security.

articleTitle: The Quick Survey Technology for the Three-no Equipment
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: The equipment which has not been operated, maintain, and switched beyond a specified interval is called three-no equipment. As the three-no equipment will cause some danger power network operation, a quick survey technology is proposed in this paper. The technique simulates artificial retrieval in the third subarea of the secondary security protection system. The technique works in a self-adaptive, divided-period, no-repeat way. Meanwhile, new equipment doesn't need to access and original network settings don't need to change. After the last action time of equipment is obtained by the computer in a short time, the difference between the last active time of equipment and the current time is used to take advice for check operation. An artificial equipment survey can be taken by computer automatically. The results of the actual case also show that the proposed technique is effective.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Algorithm of Path Planning for Automated Guided Vehicle in Complex Industrial System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: With the improvement of production efficiency, the rise of labor cost and the enhancement of health awareness, the demands for Automated Guided Vehicle (AGV) are increased for industry. AGV under industry environment is the research hot spots of handling equipment. Autonomous path planning is the core task of autonomous motion control for AGV. The accurate and effective paths are planned, and dangerous obstacles is avoided by AGV availably for handling safety. Hybrid path planning approach of AGV in complex industrial system is presented in this paper. This method is combined global and local path planning algorithm based on the analysis of vehicle motion mathematical model. Modified bidirectional A* algorithm is used in global path planning and velocity obstacles algorithm is used in local one. Simulation results show that the proposed method is feasible.

articleTitle: Research on Innovative Clustering Method of Product Design Optimized by Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Apply the ant colony algorithm to cluster analysis of the acquired data, by optimizing the K-means cluster analysis method, derive the application model on this basis, apply the data mining program to give the basic data, and find the relevance of the data. According to the results of clustering data, design guidance is given for product design innovation, and the design innovation of intelligent robot dogs is launched based on the results of clustering data.

articleTitle: Research on Process Control of 3D Printing Technology Based on Multi-sensor Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: 3D printing, a kind of rapid prototyping technology, is a kind of technology based on digital model files, using powder metal or plastic and other bonding materials, and constructing objects by layer-by-layer printing. Increasing and improving the performance of sensors in intelligent systems is an important means to increase intelligence. According to the defects of FDM nozzle based on multi-sensor technology, in order to control the stepping motor accurately, this paper controls the acceleration and deceleration of the stepping motor, and realizes the 5-segment S acceleration and deceleration curve. On this basis, the temperature control algorithm of nozzle and hot bed is designed and verified by experiments, and good temperature control effect is achieved.

articleTitle: MPCR: Multi-path Credit Reservation Protocol
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: In today's era of heavy traffic, traffic congestion control is becoming more and more important in data center networks. To achieve the great congestion control in data centers, countless researchers are struggling to purse. ExpressPass is a distributed forward-looking congestion control mechanism based on credit reservation, which can effectively avoid network congestion and achieve network losslessness. However, it can't make full use of network resources because of its limited path diversity. This paper presents an approach called multi-path Credits Reservation (MPCR). MPCR develops a newly designed multi-path credit reservation mechanism, making full use of network links. Besides, MPCR introduces path ID, which can be used to perform load balancing and consistency scheduling. Compared with ExpressPass, the results show that MPCR has higher convergence, shorter transmission latency and greater throughput.

articleTitle: Arbitrary shape text detection method based on improved PSE network structure
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: The problem of low efficiency of text detection in natural scenes due to the Curved text or the multi-directional text, a arbitrary shape text detection method based on PSE network structure is proposed. By changing the backbone network of the original PSE and adopting a new lightweight network as backbone, and the post-processing method of the original network is optimized, which effectively improves the speed without losing the original accuracy. The experimental results show that the speed of the proposed method is 5.81 FPS/s compared with the original PSE on CTW1500 data set. The improved network has good robustness and generalization ability, and has better overall performance.

articleTitle: Vibration detection and suppression of OCP-60E mechanical press
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Aiming at the resonance problem of mechanical press, this OCP-60E mechanical press is taken as the research object, and the cause of resonance is obtained by combining software simulation with hammer method. First, the established three-dimensional model of the press is used for theoretical modal analysis. The free modal and constrained modal analysis of the crankshaft and the press machine body are carried out to obtain the frequency and vibration chart through ANSYS finite element analysis software. Then, the method of using the moving force hammer with fixed sensor and the moving sensor with fixed impact point of the force hammer are used to carry out modal experiments on the press body and the complete machine. Finally, according to the test results, the cause of resonance is determined, and the resonance of the press is caused by the excitation of the flywheel rotation itself.

articleTitle: Research on Soft Self-Destruction Program of Secrecy Module of Electronic Equipment on Seepage
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: In order to improve the security performance of electronic equipment on board, the self-destruction scheme of secrecy module is studied. Taking the missile-borne reconnaissance equipment as an example to analyze its composition and confidentiality requirements, the soft self-destruction scheme is studied according to the characteristics of soft self-destruction and hard self-destruction, which can provide a reference for the development of subsequent missile-borne reconnaissance equipment.

articleTitle: The Method of Parameter Recognition and Fault Diagnosis Based on BP Neural Network of Well Test
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Parameter recognition way of well test parameters and fault diagnosis based on BP neural network are very effective. Firstly, ten models are established, they are all researched by team members. According to the characteristics and parameter algorithm of BP neural network, the test well model is optimized, the neural network is constructed, in order to make parameter recognition. And fault diagnosis for those ten well test models. Finally, some examples prove that this method is effective.

articleTitle: Research on Data Acquistion System of Flow Workshop Based on IIoT
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: With the development of the technology related to IIoT, domestic traditional manufacturing industry is striving to achieve the goal of “Industry 4.0”. In view of the difficulties in networking heterogeneous equipment in workshops, real-time data acquistion and data sharing across platforms, which are common in domestic manufacturing enterprises, by combining the relevant technology and background knowledge of IIoT, the communication principle of industrial control signals between a variety of heterogeneous devices is studied. A data acquisition and visual monitoring system for flow shop based on multi-protocol conversion is designed and implemented from three aspects: data acquisition layer, data analysis layer and data service layer. The problem of communication difficulties between different communication protocols in industrial control is solved, and the interconnection between heterogeneous devices with different communication interfaces and different communication protocols in the flow shop is realized. It provides data support services for the workshop to optimize the production plan and reduce the production cost. Verified by the actual case, the data acquisition system is of great significance for the realization of heterogeneous equipment networking and automatic data acquisition and analysis in the flow shop.

articleTitle: Countermeasures and System Design of Campus Network Information Security Defense Based on Data Encryption Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: With the surge of educational informationization, campus network, as an important infrastructure of school informationization, takes on the tasks of school teaching, scientific research, management and foreign exchange. Due to many reasons, such as the uneven ability and level of equipment, users and managers, various security problems emerge one after another, and the information security of campus network directly affects all the work of the school. Computer system paralysis, campus network paralysis, state secrets, school secrets leakage, personal files damaged, changed, leaked and other issues make network security an important work in current network construction and network management, and it is also a problem that every individual who uses the network and computer should consider and pay attention to. Using data encryption technology to solve security risks has become a development upsurge of computer industry. This paper explores the current situation of campus network information security, and puts forward relevant suggestions according to the current specific situation, hoping to improve the security and reliability of campus network information.

articleTitle: Simulation of electric field distribution in cable joint with different structural parameter and installation parameter
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: The joint of 10kV cable is a kind of cable accessory that needs to be installed outdoors. It is an important research direction to analyze the influence of different structural parameters and installation parameters on the electric field distribution in the cable joint. In this manuscript, the finite element method is used to simulate the electric field distribution of a two-dimensional axisymmetric cable joint model under the condition of power frequency. By changing the distance between the stress cone and the high-voltage shield, the influence of this structure parameter on the distribution of the electric field of the joint is analyzed. The influence of installation parameters on the electric field distribution of the cable is analyzed by changing the lap length of the semi-conductive layer. The results show that the distance between the stress cone root and the high-voltage shield should be between 74-84mm, and the lap length of the semi-conductive layer outside the cable and the stress cone should be between 29-32mm.

articleTitle: Batch Addition Method of Contact in Dynamics Simulation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Taking the special ammunition feeding system for a certain unmanned platform as an example, this paper introduces batch addition method to replace manual addition of the contact between bullet and the gun body by means of macros combined with cyclic function. With the verification of contact between 50 bullets and the core body, the adding efficiency can be improved by 88%, and the repetition and missing items in the manual adding process can be avoided at the same time. This method can be widely used in the simulation of similar structures such as chain drive system, automatic weapon feeding system for continuous shooting and track system.

articleTitle: Automated Thalamus Segmentation in MR Images Using Convolutional Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Thalamus segmentation in Magnetic Resonance Image is a challenging task because of the high inter-patient anatomical variability in both shape and size between patients. In this work, we proposed a fast and robust segmentation of thalamus using convolutional neural networks. First, cropped image which included the thalamus are extracted. Convolutional neural network (CNN) is then trained to segment the whole thalamus region. Intensity constrained model is constructed to obtain the final segmentation. Our method performs better than other state-of-the-art methods. The experiment results show that our approach achieves the highest dice scores than other methods.

articleTitle: Thermal Simulation Analysis for Power Lithium-Ion Battery Module Based on Composite Phase Change Material
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: In order to investigate temperature field distribution for the battery module with composite phase change material (CPCM), a coupled heat model of it combining the heat generation model of single cell, heat transfer model of the CPCM and pyrolytic graphite sheets (PGS) was established, and the thermal simulation analysis of the phase change cooling process of the module under discharge condition was carried out by using the Ansys Fluent. The results indicate that at the end of discharge, the maximum temperature, the maximum temperature difference and the maximum liquid phase rate of the battery module is 45.8 °C, 4.2 °C and 0.57, respectively, so the phase change cooling system can meet the maximum temperature and temperature uniformity requirements of the battery module.

articleTitle: A New Type of Key Agreement Mechanism between Electric Meters and Extended Modules
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: This paper analyzes the defects of key agreement mechanism between traditional electricity meters and extended modules, and proposes a new type of key agreement mechanism between them. By adding the serial number of extended modules in the command of session key agreement, this approach helps to distinguish which extended module has achieved communication and realizes the purpose of communicating with several extended modules. In addition, this paper comes up with a white list verification method. Each time when conducting the key agreement, it is necessary to judge whether the input scattering factor is included in the white list. If not, it will cease to conduct the session key agreement operation.

articleTitle: Research on new energy data sharing platform based on IOT identification and positioning technology
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: The construction and maintenance of new energy stations involves multi-parties, such as site-built users, site investors, site constructors, site operators, equipment suppliers, and government regulatory departments. Due to the different demands and transactions for each entity, the application systems should also be different. “Isolated Island of Data” problem formed, because data resources distribute in various business systems, and information interactions are complexly. To solve problems above, this paper proposes a new energy data sharing platform technical solution that integrates Internet of Things identification and positioning technology. The paper gives an architecture for a new energy data sharing platform technical, and analyzed the beneficial effects of the new energy data sharing platform application. The result shows the data sharing platform can effectively get through the isolated islands of information between multi-agent systems in the industrial chains of new energy stations. The solution is practical significant to the interconnection of multiple main systems.

articleTitle: Template matching based on deformation diversity similarity and scale filtering
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: To solve the problem that deformation diversity similarity (DDIS) has poor matching effects on rotation and multi-scale objects, a more robust template matching algorithm is proposed to deal with such conditions. The location distance of the nearest neighbor pairs is calculated by strengthening the constraint of the apparent features of the object on the location distance in polar coordinate system. The new confidence map composed of the DDIS response values is obtained and take the position with the highest values as the object center. The scale image pyramid is built according to the template to train the scale filter, and the scale filter is carried out on target image to determine the object scale. Experimental results show that the template matching effect of the proposed algorithm is better than DDIS, the new calculation method of location distance can effectively improve the robustness for rotating object and the scale filter can achieve the adaptive scale of object. Combining those two factors can further improve the matching accuracy.

articleTitle: FMCW SAR Imaging Based on Compressed Sensing
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Based on the sparse distribution of targets, compressed sensing theory has been widely used in the field of SAR imaging technology. The FMCW radar can be miniaturized. Based on the FMCW SAR imaging technology of compressed sensing, this paper analyzes the echo model of the signal and the theory of compressed sensing. The sparse representation of the signal is given, and the base matrix is constructed, and the distance of the target is obtained by OMP algorithm. The two-dimensional image of the target is obtained by combining the matching filtering method, which verifies the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Application of Case Retrieval Algorithm Based on Variable Weighted Grey Relation in Urban Rail Transit Network Operation Pattern Database
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Under networked conditions, the growing number of subway lines means exponential increase in energy consumption. In an emergency, if the train still executes the previous operation chart, it will consume more energy. Therefore, the main research problem of this article is to quickly find the operation diagram suitable for the train's emergency situation in the current networked line through the improvement of the case database design, so as to achieve the optimal total energy consumption of the subway network and achieve the purpose of energy saving. Based on the relevant theories of case-based reasoning, this paper introduces a comprehensive weight adjustment method based on rough set and conditional information entropy method, and a case retrieval method based on two-stage variable weight gray correlation degree in the urban rail transit network operation pattern database applications.

articleTitle: A Preliminary Study on Physical Simulation of Puppet Structure Based on Unity
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: The traditional culture of Chinese puppet show has a long history and is an ancient art form of “film and television animation” in China. It is also a precious intangible cultural heritage. With the development of modern film and television art, its development is declining day by day. This paper combines Unity physical simulation technology with traditional puppet art to study the innovative application of digital technology in traditional art form, and tries to inherit the control technology of Chinese puppet structure more completely. The research work includes physical simulation technology and traditional puppet model, rigid-body dynamics simulation of puppet model in Unity, and synchronous interaction between puppet structure and virtual puppet Unity.

articleTitle: Research on influencing factors of college students' academic security based on campus data
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Based on the literature survey and Delphi method, this paper collected the experts' views on the influencing factors of College students' academic security. Taking the campus data of 1496 students as the research object, this paper identified the key influencing factors of academic security with factor analysis method, established an evaluation system of 4 categories and 11 specific indicators. Based on the major influencing factors as financial situation, learning effect, habit, disciplinary performance and other factors, corresponding suggestions were put forward for better academic performance and security.

articleTitle: Improved FCM based distance regularization level set algorithm for image segmentation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Considering the traditional contour initialization with high sensitivity to noise limitation in original level-set algorithm, this paper proposes a Distance Regularized Level Set Evolution (DRLSE) evolution model based on the morphological reconstruction FCM algorithm. First, morphological reconstruction (MR) is used to smooth and denoise the image. Under the premise of ensuring anti-noise and image detail preservation, the image is clustered and segmented as the initial contour of DRLSE evolution, and finally the clustering result is segmented by DRLSE model evolution. . The experiment is carried out on multiple images. The segmentation results of the algorithm in this paper are significantly better than the traditional FCM algorithm and DRLSE model, which improves the accuracy of segmentation and is robust to noise.

articleTitle: A Short-term Power Load Prediction Model Based on Morlet WNN
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Power load is the key to work of regional grid. The stability of the regional power grid will be improved if we can predict the power load in short term. So, this paper provides a new hybrid model to forecast electric power in short term based on generalized extremum learning machine (GELM) and Morlet wavelet neural net (WNN). Firstly, regarding power load probability as model output, this model will cut power load information into different parts according to frequency attributes using wavelet function, and then every part will be analyzed with similar scaler. Secondly, the WNN is trained quickly by the GELM. After randomly picking deviation between hidden layer and input coefficient, some output coefficient will be got by generalized inverse transformation of matrix. Then, after the displacement coefficient and scale coefficient of Morlet function being randomly selected, the hidden layer coefficients are gained with matrix inversion, and then the Morlet WNN is designed out. Finally, taking load data of some regional power grid as experimental data, the results show that the proposed model has high accuracy and reliability, which proves the high effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Evaluation of a Power Module Accelerated Degradation Test Data Based on Weibull Pseudo-life Method
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Evaluation reliability of high-reliability and long-life electronic equipment under multiple stress conditions is urgently needed. Based on the Weibull pseudo-life test evaluation method, this paper analyzes the accelerated degradation test data of a certain type of communication equipment power module. Firstly, this paper introduces the accelerated test plan of a certain type of communication equipment power module, and gives the method of pseudo life test evaluation. Secondly, based on the Generalized Irene-Polynomial model, combined with the actual power unit test program, the parameter Bootstrap method is used to obtain the interval estimation of the model parameters. Finally, the reliability and confidence interval of the power module under normal stress are given.
