articleTitle: Coding Metasurface for Radar Cross Section Reduction
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: In recent years, the concept of metasurface has been proposed and developed, researchers has also put forward its some applications, such as introducing an abrupt phase shift, polarization conversion and holography et al. Additionally, metasurface is used to realize the RCS reduction. In this article, we have proposed three coding metasurface patterns and have simulated their RCS reduction performance. The results indicated that all the three patterns can redirect the incident EM energy to all directions and form diffuse scattering, the RCS has been reduced. Comparing their RCS reduction curve, we found that the more the super element the better the RCS reduction at all frequency band. These studies will provide evidence for designing the better coding metasurface.

articleTitle: Research on Node Sorting Method for Aviation Network Based on Kernel Extreme Learning Machine
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Correctly sorting the nodes of aviation network by technical method has important practical significance and application value for normal network operation. A node sorting method based on Kernel Extreme Learning Machine (KELM) is proposed for aviation network. Firstly, it evaluates the comprehensive importance of nodes through complex indices, and then the simple indices such as node degree value, point strength, and K-shell value are seelcted, finally KELM is introduced to establish the mapping relationship between simple indices and comprehensive importance. The simulation shows that it is effective and feasible to apply the method to sort the nodes of aviation network.

Index Terms: Importance Of Nodes In The Network

articleTitle: Big Data Adaptive Encryption Technology for Remote Network Storage
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: The traditional network storage big data encryption method had the problem of taking a long time to encrypt. The adaptive encryption technology of big data storage with remote network in the context of big data was proposed. The adaptive encryption principle to shorten the encryption program, selected based on the principles of the selected encryption designed adaptive encryption operation structure, through the calculation of chaos in the structure to realize remote network adaptive storing big data encryption. Through the calculation of the chaotic encryption process of big data in the model, the encryption of adaptive storage big data with remote network was realized. Simulation test was carried out in the simulated environment. The structure showed that the design remote network storage big data adaptive encryption technology taked 14% less time than the traditional encryption technology, the adaptive encryption method of big data showed good performance with the short time consumed of 2186s, and had high operating efficiency.

articleTitle: Application Progress of ERP in EEG-based Psychological Research
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: As the product of brain human mental activity, the basic real-time performance of brain cell activity is revealed when EEG is generated and changed. Thus, extracting mental activity information from EEG to reveal the brain mechanism of mental activity has always been an important direction of psychological research. By using computer superposition technology, the brain electrical signals generated by the mental activity of the brain can be extracted from the spontaneous power generation. The extracted waveform signals are evoked potentials, which are real real-time waveform of the EEG caused stimulus events including physical stimulation and psychological factors of which current time resolution can be accurate to microsecond level. The current ERP research on cognitive brain mechanisms is not limited to primary perceptual category, but has gone deep into the in-depth study of all aspects of human social behavior such as pre-behavior decision-making, behavior monitoring, behavioral consequences prediction and evaluation, behavioral correctness and error, and behavioral inhibition. With its unique advantages of high time resolution, ERP continues to play an irreplaceable role in the in-depth development of cognitive neuroscience, showing strong development prospects and broad application prospects.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Model Based on Optimal Neural Network Structure
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Depth of neural network in the choice of network structure, the activation function and the optimization function aspect, mainly rely on the experience of the operator to determine, led to its optimization in swarm intelligence algorithm (SI), only in the specific network structure to find the optimal weights and bias, limiting the depth of the further development of neural network in fault diagnosis field. Therefore, this paper proposes a fault diagnosis model which combines adaptive genetic algorithm and deep feed-forward network. Through the verification of MNIST, CIFAR10 standard data set and CSTV simulation experiment data, the fault diagnosis accuracy of the proposed fault diagnosis model is significantly improved compared with the original model, which is 12.95% higher on the CIFAR10 data set and 99.03% higher on the MNIST data set. On the CSTV simulation experimental data, the fault diagnosis model proposed in this paper achieves 99.994% accuracy in fault diagnosis accuracy, convergence speed and stability due to the original model, and it does not require experimentals to debug the neural network parameters, which improves the efficiency of training neural network.

articleTitle: Research on Website Group Data Monitoring System Based on Sensitive Words Filtering
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Taking Chongqing Three Gorges Medical College as the research object, we design and implement a website group data monitoring system based on sensitive words filtering. The monitoring target of the system is the website group data, and this system is designed using C/S architecture, and using broadband or mobile network working mode. The programming language is Python, and the database is MySQL. This system can provide effective support for monitoring the data of Chongqing Three Gorges Medical College, and can also provide references for the relevant units.

articleTitle: Short Term Prediction of Colleges Building Itemized Energy Consumption Based on Long Short-term Memory Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: With the rapid development of Chinese colleges, the proportion of building energy consumption in total building energy consumption is rapidly expanding. The prediction of building energy consumption in colleges has become an increasingly important research topic in recent years. However, the most current building energy consumption forecasting models focus on the prediction research of the total energy consumption, but fewer about the perceptions of itemized building energy consumption. To solve this problem, an itemized energy consumption short term prediction model is given in this paper, which is based on long short-term memory (LSTM) neural networks. The input data include total history building energy consumption, local weather characteristics, date characteristics, and time characteristics. According to the results of experiments, an accurate prediction of lighting energy consumption and special energy consumption can be given by this model, which accounts for 96.51% of the total building energy. Moreover, the LSTM model can also achieve smaller computational complexity with little difference in prediction accuracy compared with other combined models.

articleTitle: A simulation on Raman spectra of SF6 decomposition characteristic gas: a density functional theory study
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> partial discharge decomposition characteristic component analysis method is one of the most efficient and convenient technology to diagnose latent defects in SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> gas insulated equipment. Compared with the traditional SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> characteristic decomposition gas detection method, the spectral method has many outstanding advantages, such as non-destructive detection of gas, high detection speed, high precision, and no need for mixed gas separation. However, the Raman characteristics of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> partial discharge decomposition characteristic gas have not been fully clarified. Therefore, based on the density functional theory, the Raman spectra of SOF2 and SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> are calculated, which lays a solid theoretical foundation for SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> gas insulated equipment insulation fault diagnosis and condition monitoring method based on spectral technology.

articleTitle: Optimized Design of Worm Gear and Worm Drive of a Certain Shipborne Antiriot Launcher Based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Worm gear and worm drive mechanism is widely used in mechanical drive. In traditional design, the valuation trial method is generally used, and then the design scheme is checked to verify whether the design parameters are within the performance range for the given conditions. In a sense, the design parameter values obtained by this method are not the most reasonable and economical. Under the premise of systematic study of the possible failure forms and design criteria of worm gear and worm drive, design criteria and use of materials, we determine the optimization design objectives, design variables and constraints, and use the MATLAB optimization toolbox to complete the optimized design of worm gear and worm drive. We finally obtain the optimization results and compare them with the original design data. The optimization results show that MATLAB can significantly improve the analysis efficiency and quality of worm drive design, which will reduce the cost.

articleTitle: RFID-based membership card consumption query system
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Radio frequency identification (RFID) technology is the key to the Internet of things industry implementation and fall to the ground, one of the core technology has been widely used in our daily life, People's Daily use of public transportation card, school canteen selling the window of the consumption system, large pig ear tag tracking system, vaccine production source tracing and has been applied in underground garage parking consumption system, etc. The wide application of RFID technology has brought great convenience and security to people's life and also improved people's management effect and efficiency. With past product labels, bar code and other similar products, compared the RFID technology form a complete set of radio frequency identification card has better advantage: not easy to fold, not easy to damage, reading and writing speed and non-contact identification, safety performance is higher, can set up a series of security collision detection), will not be damaged because of the weather reason, to adapt to the environment ability. Based on this, this paper designs a membership card consumption query system based on RFID technology and tests the performance of the system.

articleTitle: Improved query model for rapidly query based on distributed hash index
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Aiming at the low efficiency of the Big data query of the internet of Things, the research based on the smart urban management platform, and on the premise of retaining the original platform data integration framework. The query model and process are redesigned and a new data improved query model is proposed by introducing hash coding, distributed index and data dictionary. Compared with the one by one comparison query method, the speed of the improved query model is increased by 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup> times when processing millions of data, which significantly improves the query efficiency of big data. The research results can help improve the data processing and analysis ability of Chongqing Liangjiang Smart Urban Management Platform in China.

articleTitle: Study equipment failure diagnose based on multiple signals and sensors
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Among the various kinks of components which make up the entire large ordnance, the electromechanical equipments take over large amounts. In order to accomplish the schedule mission, the electromechanical equipments must be kept in health condition. Thus the capability of failure diagnose must be improved besides the capability of reliability and maintainability. In the study, the centrifugal pump is taken as an example. Firstly, the function significant items are confirmed by the method of logic decision. The failure modes are analyzed in details. The diagnose method of each mode are given as well as the corresponding sensors. In the end, the method of failure diagnose based on multiple signals is verified though experiment system, which shows it can guide the design of newly developed equipments or the failure diagnose system in the operation.

articleTitle: Audio-Visual Single-Channel Signal Separation Based on Big Data Augmentation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Cocktail party problem has attracted more attentions in recent years in the speech community. Specially, the single-channel multi-talker speech separation and recognition has become a research hotspot. Also, the visual based information has also been adopted to improve the performance of speech separation and speech recognition. In this paper, we explored to improve the baseline permutation invariant training (PIT) based speech separation systems by two data augmentation methods. Firstly, the visual based information is selected to determine the permutation of separated speakers and also improve the separation performance. Besides, the SpecAugment was explored with big data augmentation method to improve the performance of separation. Finally, we achieved dB of SDR on a mixed dataset using TCD-TIMIT corpus.

articleTitle: Non-fragile fault detection for Lipschitz nonlinear system with quantization and missing measurement
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: The non-fragile fault detection filter is investigated for discrete-time Lipschitz nonlinear system subject to quantization and missing measurements in this paper. The measurements are quantized by logarithmic quantizer. The transmission of the measurements is described by a Markov Chain with two states. The fault detection system is formulated as a Markovian jumping system. The sufficient condition for the existence of non-fragile fault detection filter is derived in form of linear matrix inequality. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is illustrated by a numerical example.

articleTitle: Improved Kalman Filter for MEMS Thermal Mass Flowmeter
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: According to the characteristics of MEMS thermal mass flowmeter, an improved Kalman filter algorithm considering the flow variation is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the output signal of MEMS thermal mass flow meter is analyzed. Then, the condition and method of forced updating of Kalman state with the change of flow rate are proposed. The simulations and experiment of the proposed method are carried out. Compared with the Standard Kalman filtering algorithm, the response time and the measurement accuracy of the MEMS thermal mass flowmeter with the proposed method has been improved, which provide the new idea for the data processing of MEMS device.

articleTitle: Security Analysis and Improvement of Designated Verifier CLAS in Network Security Course Education
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Cryptographic algorithm plays an important role in the teaching of network security course. Certificateless aggregate signature (CLAS) scheme is an important cryptographic algorithm in cryptography. Many CLAS schemes have been proposed with some property, such as designated verifier property. Designated verifier property makes it possible for a specific person to verify the signature which can be applied in many scenes, such as medicine and biology system and et al. In this paper, we analyze a CLAS scheme with designated verifier property proposed in 2020 which satisfies designated verifiability property, unforgeability property and non-transitivity property. However, we point out that the CLAS scheme does not satisfy the unforgeability as they claimed. We present two improved methods to overcome these existed security drawbacks. By analyzing the security of a CLAS scheme and proposing some improved methods, it can let students know how to better design a secure cryptographic algorithm in process of network security course.

articleTitle: Computation and Simulation on Energy Band of Graphene Nanoribbons
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Models of armchair graphene nano ribbons (AGNR) and zigzag graphene nanoribbons (ZGNR) are constructed and the energy band of these graphene nanostructures are calculated using semi empirical extended huckel molecular orbital (EHMO) tight binding method. Based on the extended Huckel molecular orbital model, the electronic structures of graphene nanostructures were simulated and analyzed using ATK/VNL simulation platform. The simulation results are in good agreement with those of tight binding model and first principles density functional theory reported earlier, which verifies the accuracy of the calculation of the electronic structure of carbon atoms in graphene by using Cerda Shockey set empirical parameters.

articleTitle: Research on Design of Nuclear Island Actuator Module Discrepancy Alarms in Nuclear Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: The discrepancy alarm is introduced into the digital nuclear power plant as to monitor the equipment status. Early discrepancy alarm design is not perfect and lead to that lots of discrepancy alarms cannot be reset. This paper analyses the mechanism of discrepancy alarm and the reason why it cannot be reset. Combining with the characteristics of special actuators of nuclear power plant, this paper gives a reasonable and feasible implementation solutions and provides reference ideas for the discrepancy alarm design of nuclear power plant.

articleTitle: Detection on Difficult Small Objects Using Layer-wise Training Strategy
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Training strategy is a common condition which has considerable impact on the performance of deep learning networks. In this work, we propose a layer-wise training strategy which contains layers freezing, hard examples training and loss changing during training. Training networks using layer-wise training strategy can transfer pre-trained weights to similar tasks more efficiently. We detail about the way of freezing different layers in different epochs, which is associated with better stability. We also use small objects as training dataset, and it improves detection capabilities of networks on difficult small objects. The study offers some important insights into neural networks training. We further analyze the advantage of layer-wise training strategy and prove it efficient in experiments. Our method achieves superior accuracy over Fast R-CNN and Mask R-CNN on MS COCO dataset. We also detect photos contains difficult small objects using different models, and models trained by our strategy prove more efficient.

articleTitle: Frequency Planning for Non-dedicated Relay Node Relay Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: In the context of joint tactical communication, traditional single-hop ultrashort wave networking has been unable to meet communication needs due to the large operational area and complex geographical environment. Aiming at the problem that the first-level communication node and its secondary communication node are interrupted due to long distance or obstacle blocking, the frequency reuse scheme based on the secondary communication node is designed and proposed. The disconnection reconnection mechanism is based on the reconnection and the genetic algorithm is used for the frequency planning of the relay node. The invention solves the problem that the traditional algorithm has a prohibitive time complexity and the selected frequency has a large cumulative interference value.

articleTitle: Analysis and Optimization of Chamber-Loading Route of a Certain Type of Rifle
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Aiming at the jamming failure in the development test of a certain type of rifle, the dynamic modeling and fault reproduction of the chamber-loading process are carried out by using the multi-rigid-body dynamics simulation software. It is concluded that the main reason is that when the number of ammunition in the magazine decreases, the pressure of the supporting spring decreases as the firing progresses, and the constraint of the guide part of the magazine on the ammunition increases. As a result, the constraint of the ammunition is premature at the initial stage of firing. For these reasons, the guide part of the magazine is optimized, and the optimized structure is simulated and analyzed. The simulation results show that after optimization, the lateral force time of the magazine on the bullet is delayed by 0.004s, and the trajectory of the bullet tip is reduced by 4.7mm compared with the lateral displacement. Therefore, the firing route is optimized.

articleTitle: Signal Integrity Simulation Design and Analysis of Electronic Article Surveillance PCB for RFID applications
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: The modern electronics industry is working for miniaturization of electronic devices will ultimately call for the dense design of PCB, shrinking geometry of ICs and high speed interference. Mostly communication devices operate on low power and high frequency. As shrinking of the silicon wafer area significantly increases the interconnection problems. Crosstalk, impedance mismatch, reflection, skew, and propagation delay are major issues that are caused by interconnection and limit the performance of the high-speed design. This paper presents Signal Integrity (SI) simulation design analysis by using Cadence Allegro SPB Software. For this purpose, Input/Output Buffer Information Specification (IBIS) models are assigned to simulate reflection and crosstalk. Signal integrity analysis is performed and improvement in simulation design is presented which enhances the design intuitively and validates high speed PCB analysis.

articleTitle: Production Resumption Analysis for Different Industries by K-means Clustering
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: At the beginning of 2020, the COVID-19 suddenly struck, which had a great impact on industrial production, causing most companies to shut down. To further study the work and production resumption progress for industrial users, this paper analyzes the electricity consumption data from a total of 200 users in four industries including heavy industries, general industry and commerce, agricultural production industries, and agricultural irrigation and drainage industries in a city in Eastern China before and after the Spring Festival and pandemic. K-means clustering with Silhouette Coefficient is adopted as the primary tool to analyze the resumption thresholds for different industries. Combined with these thresholds, the industry resumption rate curve is further drawn, and the resumption rate of each industry one month before and after the Spring Festival is analyzed to provide support for in-depth analysis of the impact of the pandemic on different industries.

articleTitle: Development and application of multi-component dynamic gas distribution instrument based on mass flow controller
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Sulfur hexafluoride (SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>) equipment plays an important role in the power system. SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> gas in the equipment not only plays the role of insulation and arc suppression, but also is the information carrier of the equipment status. The moisture, impurities and leakage in SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> gas is an important index and basis to evaluate the state of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> electrical equipment. Therefore, how to make good use of all kinds of testers to analyze and monitor SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> gas is the most important thing. At present, in order to solve the problems of high standard gas cost, short period of validity and long ordering cycle, which are needed in the calibration of these instruments, we are indicated to research an eight-component dynamic gas distribution device based on mass flow controller (MFC) in this paper. Based on MFC theory, through relevant hardware and software design, the device obtains a gas distribution instrument for continuously preparing and supplying eight-component mixed standard gas with continuously adjustable concentration, so as to meet the calibration needs of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> component analyzer, purity meter and leak detector. Compared with the four groups, the eight-group gas distribution instrument just needs to connect the dynamic gas distribution device and the gas pipeline of the tested instrument when verifying the SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> decomposition product instrument, and simple parameter setting in the computer management system. The computer automatically controls the single-component or multi-component mixed standard gas needed for the configuration and verification of the dynamic gas distribution system through serial communication, and it do not need to change the gas path. At the same time, the device can check the multiple instruments by simple operation.

articleTitle: Interactive Reading System Based on AI
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: In the existing enrollment teaching training, the low ratio of teachers / students causes small training scale and low training efficiency. In order to solve this problem, an interactive enrollment system based on AI is designed. The system mainly includes four modules: speech recognition module, evaluation and analysis module, comprehensive data module and scenario interface module. It realizes the functions of human-computer interaction, scenario design/import, realtime automatic scoring, teaching data analysis and so on. The introduction of enrollment system will effectively improve the training efficiency and expand the training scale.

articleTitle: Test and Optimization of Large-scale Ceph System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: This article shares a test and optimization case based on a large-scale Ceph system, which covers functional testing, high availability testing and performance testing. In the process of deployment and testing, we find the OSD number confusion, the exorbitant initial cluster capacity, abnormal PG state of cluster, discrepancy of properties and expectations or other problems. We analyze the above problems, put forward corresponding solutions and verify. In the performance test, we carried out a theoretical estimation and stress test for the performance. The test results show that the large-scale Ceph system can run stably in production environment with high availability, and can show 50% increase high performance after proper optimization.

articleTitle: A linear algorithm on Steiner domination of trees
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: If the closed neighborhood of a set W of graph G includes all vertices in graph G, we call W a dominating set of graph G. If the set W is also a Steiner set, it is called a Steiner dominating set. The minimum cardinality of a Steiner dominating set of G is called the Steiner domination number, denoted by γ st(G). We pose an algorithm which construct a minimum Steiner dominating set for a tree T in linear time.

articleTitle: An Data Expanding Method of Sound Recognition Based on Generative Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: At present, deep learning has made some progress in the application of sound recognition. However, there are two great challenges in this field. Firstly, the vector of the sound data is very large. Secondly, the number of audio data is lack. The two problems lead to low recognition rate with insufficient audio data. This paper proposes a data enhance approach which based on gene rative adversarial network (GAN) to generate new audio data. In this paper, we establish GAN to produce new train data. Then, we remove the noise in the generated data. Finally, we train a classifier using all the data to recognize the audio data. Experimental results shows that the proposed approach in speech recognition plays great performance.

articleTitle: Detecting happy and sad exclamations in Mandarin with acoustic features
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Emotion recognition has been a hot and significant topic in Natural Language Processing, human-computer interaction as well as sentiment analysis technology. Exclamation, either happiness or sadness, is a very typical sentence type to express strong emotions in everyday communication, social medias, customers' responses to services and products and cross-cultural communication. Moreover, both types of exclamation can share the identical literal form but express distinctively different emotions by means of linguistic contexts and intonation devices. However, not much is known about their subtle but unique speech features. To shed light on this demanding issue for sentiment analysis and human-computer reaction, the present study explores the two facets of exclamation in Mandarin Chinese (Putonghua) in order to probe into the acoustic features. The findings reveal that happy exclamation differs from sad exclamation in their overall sentence duration, subpart intonation phrase duration, average sentence pitch level, maximum pitch as well as pitch range. These prime distinctions in duration and pitch parameters provide insights into robust AI -based emotion recognition of speech.

articleTitle: A Multi-Stage DCNN Method for Liver Tumor Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Medical image segmentation is one of the most important tasks in machine learning. In order to help with the doctors, we focus on computer-aided automatic computer tomography (CT) segmentation of liver tumors. Instead of using a single model during the segmentation process, we argue that the filter made by the model of object detection before segmentation could improve the accuracy of segmentation. From the motivation above, we proposed a multi-stage deep convolutional neural network (DCNN) model, which can be used for segmentation of the tumors in the livers. To further improve the accuracy of the object detection model, we proposed an iterative training method which boosts the performance of our model and yield more accurate localization of the tumors. Finally, the evaluation of proposed method on our private dataset from hospital and public dataset from MICCAI-LiTS2017 suggested that our model is superior to the current state-of-the-art models.

articleTitle: Security Issues and Challenges in RFID, Wireless Sensor Network and Optical Communication Networks and Solutions
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Nowadays, Security is the biggest challenge in communication networks. Well defined security protocols not only solve the privacy and security issues but also help to reduce the implementation cost and simplify network's operation. Network society demands more reliable and secure network services as well as infrastructure. In communication networks, data theft, hacking, fraud, cyber warfare are serious security threats. Security as defined by experts is confirming protected communication amongst communication/computing systems and consumer applications in private and public networks, it is important for promising privacy, confidentiality, and protection of information. This paper highlights the security related issues and challenges in communication networks. We also present the holistic view for the underlaying physical layer including physical infrastructure attacks, jamming, interception, and eavesdropping. This research focused on improving the security measures and protocols in different communication networks.

articleTitle: CS-GANomaly: A Supervised Anomaly Detection Approach with Ancillary Classifier GANs for Chromosome Images
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Although anomaly detection is an urgent and significant task in various applications, there are few good enough methods to meet the requirements. The challenge of anomaly detection lies in how to distinguish the diverse or even unknown anomalies. Therefore, previous studies have focused on imagelevel anomaly detection tasks, and mostly based on unsupervised methods. These methods only consider the characteristics of normal samples and are confined to the “normal” category, ignoring information between samples. In particular, the limitations of unsupervised methods are more obvious for pixellevel abnormalities such as the chromosomal structural anomalies investigated in this paper, because the similarity between normal and abnormal samples is relatively high. In this work, we propose a supervised anomaly detection approach Classification - Enhanced GANomaly (abbreviated as CS-GANomaly). By fusing the category information with the sample, the spatial distribution of the sample has regional characteristics and then combining the anomaly detection strategies to carry out multidimension anomaly detection. The CS-GANomaly adopts the GAN framework for adversarial training and adapts the GAN output to anomaly detection. The experimental results prove the superiority of our approach, whether it is a pixel-level anomaly in abnormal chromosome dataset or image-level anomaly in the benchmark dataset.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of University Financial Management Performance Appraisal System Based on Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: In the management system of colleges and universities in China, financial management is a core component. The theoretical research and practical exploration of performance evaluation of financial departments in colleges and universities in China is still in its infancy. The step-by-step operation mode makes the financial managers in colleges and universities lack the awareness of strategic management and can't combine all kinds of related elements well. Based on the data mining technology, this paper introduces the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) into the performance appraisal of financial management in colleges and universities. Combined with some methods of data mining, we can analyze the diagnostic data from the whole or a specific project, and build a financial management performance appraisal model based on these data. It provides an effective basis for colleges and universities to improve financial management effectiveness and risk prevention ability.

articleTitle: Stochastic Maximum Principle for Delayed Backward Doubly Relaxed Stochastic Control Problem and Applications
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: We consider a measure-valued processes called relaxed controls in which an optimal solution exists, for the time delayed backward doubly stochastic differential control systems. By using the classical variational technique, a stochastic maximum principle can be deduced and it is a necessary condition of the optimal control when the set of relaxed controls is convex. In the meantime, under certain assumption, an optimality sufficient condition is gained through duality method. In the last part, our theoretical results, optimal necessary and sufficient conditions for relaxed control applied to time delayed doubly stochastic linear quadratic problem.

articleTitle: Method for Intelligent Judgment on the Resumption of Work and Production
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: The resumption of work and production helps to avoid the short-term suspension of economic development caused by COVID-19 virus epidemic from becoming long-term economic depression. However, during the COVID-19 virus epidemic, the resumption of work may cause infection. Facing the uncertainty of external environment, the pressure of capital turnover and lead time of orders, the resumption of work and production is a severe problem. To judge the schedule of resumption, we analyze the electricity usage of enterprises in Shaoxing, select 200 enterprises in 4 industries, including heavy industries, general industry and commerce, agricultural production industries, agricultural irrigation and drainage industries. Using the electricity usage before and after the epidemic, we use STL decomposition and Mann Kendall trend test to intelligently judge the situation of resumption. At the same time, combined with the date of suspension and resumption of work, we determine the resumption threshold of enterprises and plot the resumption rate of industries. From the threshold and the plots, we can analyze the schedule of resumption one month before and after the Spring Festival to support the effect of epidemic on different industries.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Multidimensional Data Analysis and Decision Platform for Smart Factory
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Technology is constantly developing and data is constantly increasing. Many companies are facing the challenge of multi-dimensional and large amounts of data. Dealing with redundant information and noisy data, and the invalidity of mining results have become difficult problems. Taking the display smart factory as an example, this paper designs a multi-dimensional data analysis and decision-making platform based on Hadoop, uses the deep learning model to analyze the collected system data, and draws resource scheduling plans and quality control decision-making plans, assists management decisions, and realizes intelligence Factory intelligent production, networked collaborative manufacturing. From this, it can improve production efficiency, reduce production costs, reduce operation intensity, etc., while enhancing the core competitiveness of the factory in the industry.

articleTitle: A New Spectrum Sensing Method with Low SNR under Laplace Noise
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Aiming at the existing spectrum detection technology, under the condition of low SNR, especially under the background of non-Gaussian noise, the detection performance is low and the detection time is long. This paper fully combines the advantages of energy detection and sequential detection. According to the characteristics of non-Gaussian noise, a new method of spectrum sensing with low SNR under Laplace noise is proposed. For the proposed method, we first divide the received signal equidistantly in the background of Laplace noise, and then use the sequential detection method to achieve a predetermined good detection probability. The simulation results verify the correctness of our theoretical derivation and show that the proposed scheme is correct. Compared with energy detection under Laplacian noise, this method has the advantages of short detection time, small sample size, small influence of noise uncertainty, and good performance under low SNR. In addition, the proposed method can effectively counter the influence of fading channels on detection performance.

articleTitle: Overview of Cognitive Radio Security Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Cognitive radio is to acquire spectrum information by sensing information from the environment through artificial intelligence technology. On the premise of not interfering with the primary user, cognitive radio can access the idle spectrum in real time, change the transmission power of wireless communication system, so as to meet the spectrum requirements of more users and improve the utilization of spectrum resources. However, with the development of cognitive radio technology, it also brings a series of security challenges. Starting from the accuracy and real-time performance of cognitive spectrum sensing, the correctness of spectrum analysis, and the optimization of communication, this paper introduces four security issues, namely, dynamic spectrum access, MAC layer security, artificial intelligence threat and cross layer attack. It also summarizes the existing security solutions and gives suggestions for the security of cognitive radio network.

articleTitle: High-precision spatial positioning optimization method based on probability of error
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: This thesis proposes a spatial three-dimensional positioning optimization method based on error probability, based on the positioning method based on time difference of arrival (TDOA), through the research on the positioning of substation inspection operators and equipment under complex working conditions, The method used optimizing the distance difference between the node to be positioned and different base stations can effectively improve the positioning accuracy of the staff and equipment in the station. The test results in a complex power frequency electric field environment show that the calculated results of this optimization method are better than the existing traditional positioning methods, and can effectively improve the positioning accuracy under line-of-sight conditions and realize the positioning of moving targets in the substation space.

articleTitle: An Imbalanced Data Classification Method Based on Multi-Kernel Extreme Learning Machine Fusion
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: To solve the problem of low classification accuracy in imbalanced data classification, a method based on Multi-Kernel Extreme Learning Machine Fusion (MKELMF) is proposed. By introducing the “learning to learn” idea of meta-learning algorithm, the ability of Multi-Kernel Extreme Learning Machine (MK-ELM) to classify local areas of data samples is fully mined. For each test sample, the meta-learning algorithm selects a group of Kernel Extreme Learning Machine (KELM) with sufficient classification ability for combined decision making, avoiding the problems such as insufficient classification of single KELM and the problem that ordinary MK-ELM can easily introduce wrong classification information by making weighted decisions based on all KELM results. According to the characteristics of KELM, five evaluation criteria are proposed as meta-features for training meta-learner. We construct a serial regulating circuit and collect data under normal and fault conditions to verify the proposed method. The experimental results show that compared with two cost-sensitive SVM methods and two local multi-kernel weighted fusion methods, the MKELMF method improves the test accuracy, Macro-F1 value and G-mean by 8.53%, 4.59% and 5.37% respectively. In addition, the method has higher training and testing efficiency.

articleTitle: Microblog Popularity Prediction Based on Multimodal Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference of Safe Production and Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: The change of public opinion popularity shows complex non-linear characteristics under the joint action of many influencing factors. Taking microblog as the research object, considering the real-time and complexity of microblog, this paper analyzes the trend of microblog popularity from the aspects of microblog content, user characteristics and microblog event timeliness, and proposes a multi-modal feature fusion microblog popularity prediction algorithm. Firstly, the original features of microblog are analyzed, key features are extracted from them, and GDBT algorithm is used for feature screening. Secondly, the popularity of microblog is measured according to the information gain method. Finally, combined with XGBoost algorithm, the popularity of short-term events is predicted according to the text content, image content, video content and user influence of microblog, thus predicting the popularity value of users whose microblog events have been published, and then using LSTM algorithm to predict the overall event trend. Experiments show that. The accuracy of XGBoost algorithm in predicting the popularity value of microblog can reach 80%, while LSTM algorithm has a small RMS for predicting the overall event trend, which well predicts the overall development trend of events.
